On 10 August 2026, a newly-appointed Ambassador of the Kingdom of Morocco to ASEAN, H.E. Redouane Houssaini, presented his Letter of Credence to the Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat. Secretary-General Dr. Kao congratulated Ambassador Houssaini on his assumption of office and reaffirmed the ASEAN Secretariat’s commitment to further strengthening the ASEAN-Morocco Sectoral Dialogue Partnership established in 2023. The Secretary-General also expressed appreciation for Morocco’s support for ASEAN Community-building efforts. Ambassador Houssaini thanked Secretary-General Dr. Kao for the warm welcome. He looked forward to working closely with ASEAN Member States and the ASEAN Secretariat in further strengthening Morocco’s ties and cooperation with ASEAN during his term of office. Morocco has accredited its first Ambassador to ASEAN since 2010. Ambassador Houssaini succeeds Ambassador Ouadia Benabdellah, who completed his tenure in April 2025. Video

Addressing the nation on the 80th Independence Day, PM Modi says, "12 years ago, piped gasline was available in only 70 cities. In the last 12 years, this number has grown to 700 cities. Today, 1.75 crore households are connected to piped gas lines in the country."

#WATCH | Delhi: From the ramparts of the Red Fort, Prime Minister Narendra Modi says, "In the last 12 years, defence production has increased nearly fourfold, while output from Khadi and village industries has grown almost fivefold. Electronics manufacturing has expanded nearly sevenfold. The production of modern railway coaches has risen 21-fold, and mobile phone production has surged 33-fold. Beyond that, we have made our mark in the realms of digital technology and innovation. The number of internet users has nearly quadrupled, patent grants have increased fourfold, and digital transactions have grown a hundredfold. We have worked with equal seriousness to improve amenities for the common citizen. We have provided tap-water connections at an average annual rate 15 times faster than before. Gas connections have been provided at six times the previous annual speed. We have constructed toilets for the poor at four times the annual pace and provided housing for the underprivileged at three times the previous rate. The country has also undergone a massive transformation in governance; thousands of compliance requirements have been eliminated, and hundreds of archaic laws have been repealed. One cannot march into the 21st century relying on laws from the last century. We expanded metro networks to build modern infrastructure and strengthened public transport. The speed and scale at which this work has been executed—this momentum, this expansion, and these achievements—represent a transformation witnessed for the first time since independence, all within the last decade..." सभी देशवासियों को स्वतंत्रता दिवस की हार्दिक शुभकामनाएं।🇮🇳 राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन में अपना सर्वस्व न्योछावर करने वाले अनगिनत स्वतंत्रता सेनानियों को हम विनम्र श्रद्धांजलि अर्पित करते हैं। पिछले 79 वर्षों की हमारी यात्रा अनेक उपलब्धियों, संघर्षों और संकल्पों की यात्रा रही है। हमने बहुत कुछ हासिल किया है, लेकिन एक राष्ट्र के रूप में अभी बहुत कुछ हासिल करना बाकी है। हमारे लिए स्वतंत्रता केवल अंग्रेज़ी हुकूमत से मुक्ति नहीं है। यह संविधान से मिला वह भरोसा है, जो हर भारतीय को समानता, सम्मान, न्याय और अपनी बात कहने का अधिकार देता है। यही हमारे लोकतंत्र की सबसे बड़ी शक्ति और हर नागरिक का सबसे मजबूत सुरक्षा कवच है। बीते एक दशक में हमारे संवैधानिक मूल्यों, लोकतांत्रिक संस्थाओं और सामाजिक सद्भाव के सामने कई चुनौतियां खड़ी हुई हैं। युवाओं के सपनों को अवसर चाहिए, किसानों की मेहनत को सम्मान और न्याय चाहिए, महिलाओं को समान अधिकार और सशक्त भागीदारी चाहिए। दलितों, आदिवासियों, पिछड़ों, अल्पसंख्यकों और आर्थिक रूप से कमजोर वर्गों को संविधान में निहित समानता और न्याय का पूरा अधिकार मिलना चाहिए। इस स्वतंत्रता दिवस पर हमारा सबसे बड़ा संकल्प उम्मीद है। उम्मीद हमारे युवाओं की बुलंद आवाज़ में है, किसानों के परिश्रम में है, महिलाओं के साहस में है और करोड़ों भारतीयों के उस विश्वास में है कि हम मिलकर हर चुनौती का सामना कर सकते हैं और देश को सही दिशा दे सकते हैं। आइए, ऐसी आज़ादी की रक्षा करें जिसमें हर आवाज़ को सम्मान मिले, हर सपने को अवसर मिले और हर भारतीय को आगे बढ़ने का समान अधिकार मिले। जय हिंद।

Warm greetings to all my fellow citizens on Independence Day 🇮🇳 We pay our humble tribute to the countless freedom fighters who gave their all in the struggle for India’s freedom. Their courage, sacrifice and unwavering faith in our nation continue to inspire us. Over the past 79 years, India’s journey has been one of remarkable achievements, struggles and collective resolve. We have travelled a long way, but as a nation, many aspirations still remain unfulfilled. For us, freedom was never merely liberation from British rule. It is the assurance bestowed upon every Indian by our Constitution — of equality, dignity, justice and the freedom to speak without fear. These values remain the greatest strength of our Democracy and the strongest safeguard of every citizen. Over the past decade, our Constitutional values, democratic institutions and social harmony have faced serious challenges. Our youth deserve opportunities to fulfil their aspirations. Our farmers deserve dignity and justice for their toil. Our women deserve equality, empowerment and an equal voice in shaping India’s future. Dalits, Adivasis, OBCs, minorities and economically weaker sections must receive the full measure of equality and justice promised by our Constitution. On this Independence Day, our greatest resolve must be hope. Jai Hind.

The extended deployment of USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72) and reported supply problems appear to be tied in part to the loss of the Navy’s logistics hub in Bahrain early in the Iran war according to a report from the New York Times. Iranian missile and drone strikes heavily damaged the Naval Support Activity Bahrain, home of the U.S. Navy's 5th Fleet, forcing the Navy to shift much of its regional logistics support to Naval Support Facility Diego Garcia, roughly 2,200 miles from the carrier forces operating in the Gulf of Oman. The island subsequently became an Iranian target, with two ballistic missiles launched toward Diego Garcia on March 20; one fell short and a Navy ship intercepted the other. That logistical disruption has coincided with an unusually demanding deployment for Lincoln. The carrier has been at sea for nearly nine months without a liberty call, while supporting combat operations and the blockade of Iranian ports. Lawmakers have raised concerns about reported shortages of basic supplies and deteriorating crew morale. The Navy is now replacing Lincoln with the forward deployed USS George Washington (CVN-73), which is already transiting toward the Middle East. Another carrier, George H.W. Bush, has also been operating in the region for months.

The U.S. Army has temporarily grounded Apache helicopter training flights following the deaths of two soldiers in an AH-64E crash near Fort Hood, Texas, on Wednesday. Chief Warrant Officer 2 Deontre T. Huey, 34, and Warrant Officer Seth L. Olmsted, 25, were killed when their Apache crashed in a rural field near Salado. The crash sparked a wildfire, but no buildings were struck. The Army has not identified a cause and says the stand-down will remain in place until investigators have a better understanding of the accident. The temporary grounding affects training flights, not necessarily the entire Apache fleet. The AH-64 remains heavily used by Army and National Guard units and has also seen combat during the Iran war, including an Apache reportedly shot down by an Iranian drone over the Strait of Hormuz in June.

EL GOBIERNO OFICIALIZÓ LA FLEXIBILIZACIÓN DEL CRÉDITO EN DÓLARES A EMPRESAS El gobierno de Javier Milei oficializó la flexibilización del crédito en dólares a empresas no generadoras de divisas que había anunciado el ministro de Economía, Luis Caputo. De esta forma, el equipo económico busca reactivar la economía y aumentar el flujo de divisas. Mediante el DNU 736/2026, publicado este viernes en el Boletín Oficial, la administración libertaria modificó el artículo 23 del Decreto 905/02 que posibilita el otorgamiento de préstamos a firmas que no están vinculadas con actividades de comercio exterior. De esta manera, la nueva reglamentación establece que se permite “la constitución de depósitos en moneda extranjera en cuentas a la vista y depósitos a plazo”. Asimismo, aclara que “los fondos provenientes de dichos depósitos podrán destinarse exclusivamente a la financiación a prestatarios que tengan ingresos habituales provenientes directa o indirectamente de operaciones de comercio exterior y actividades vinculadas, así como al otorgamiento de financiaciones a otras personas jurídicas, conforme a la normativa que a tal efecto dicte el Banco Central de la República Argentina”. El decreto fundamenta la medida en un diagnóstico sobre la evolución económica del país en las últimas décadas. En sus considerandos, el Gobierno sostiene que “en los últimos 100 años la economía de la Argentina mostró un bajo crecimiento acumulado acompañado de una alta volatilidad”, lo que derivó en una pérdida gradual de posición relativa frente a otras economías del mundo. Según el texto, esa dinámica se profundizó en las últimas dos décadas y llegó a un punto crítico en diciembre de 2023, cuando la Argentina atravesaba, en palabras del decreto, “una situación de inédita gravedad”, con riesgo de hiperinflación, controles cambiarios estrictos, sin acceso al financiamiento externo y con reservas internacionales netas negativas. I have directed the Inspector-General of Police and the heads of all security agencies deployed for the election to ensure the safety of voters, electoral officials and election materials. "The world’s ability to absorb Chinese overcapacity is approaching a breaking point. And if that breaking point comes, the consequence could be a global economic crisis at a time when governments are particularly ill equipped to manage the fallout," writes CFR President @MikeFroman for @ForeignAffairs. Over the past two decades, China has established the largest trade surplus in recorded history. In 2025, it reached nearly $1.2 trillion, growing at three times the rate of global goods trade. "When the Chinese economy was substantially smaller, a strategy based on driving export growth at two or three times the rate of overall global economic growth was possible because there was sufficient global demand to absorb its exports. Today, however, China has a much larger economy and cannot continue on this trajectory without eventually running out of customers. Put simply, Beijing has outgrown its economic model." "When the Chinese export machine stalls, the reckoning will be most painful for China. But a material slowdown in its economy would send shock waves around the world, especially among China’s major trading partners, not only in the Asia Pacific but also in countries elsewhere whose economies have become intertwined with China’s. The United States would not be immune to the shock, but it would be the only actor with the economic and institutional capacity to stabilize the global economy," Froman writes. "The surest way to avoid this costly chain of events is a preemptive and gradual rebalancing of the Chinese economy. This has long been China’s best path toward more sustainable growth, and a route the United States has advocated for years. But whereas in decades past it was a smart choice, now it is a necessity." foreignaffairs.com/china/nex…

In 2014 we published the first large-scale study of suicidality in autism, subsequently widely replicated, revealing that 1 in 4 autistic people have planned or attempted suicide. That’s why I’m very concerned about the impact of the media coverage on Professor Jason Arday who is autistic. He has been accused of plagiarism and he was cleared of any academic misconduct following a rigorous investigation by Liverpool John Moores University. And yet he continues to be systematically discredited over every detail of his life, daily. We should of course always investigate plagiarism to protect academic standards. However, I cannot stand by and watch when an autistic man is on the ground and the kicking continues. This is relentless bullying of a vulnerable autistic man and raises safe-guarding issues. It’s time to stop.

New York City’s buses may not be free — but transit officials say more riders are treating them like they are. Nearly half of bus riders are now skipping the $3 fare, while paid ridership dropped nearly 8% in June and fare revenue fell $31 million during Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s first six months in office compared with the same period last year. MTA Chairman Janno Lieber says “all of the talk of free buses” is having an impact, while the city’s largest transit union says fare evasion is the worst its drivers have seen. Mamdani campaigned on “fast and free buses,” but the state-controlled MTA is already staring down a projected $300 million deficit next year — and one expert says the cost of eliminating bus fares could be roughly $1.1 billion annually.

The more details emerge, the more questions arise. Mali and Liel began their trip in Prague before arriving in Vienna last Friday. They checked into an Airbnb, and that was the last time their family received any sign of life from them. The mystery deepened when investigators discovered that their mobile phones last transmitted location signals on Saturday morning, near a market in the Austrian capital. Then came another puzzling detail: the two women apparently left their accommodation during the Shabbat, something unusual given that they are observant Jewish women. Tonight in another development: the Mossad has become involved in the investigation. But the latest details released sound almost like something out of an Agatha Christie mystery: investigators now suspect the two may have crossed into another country. Investigators are also examining indications that the two took a substantial amount of cash with them when they left Israel.. And even more strikingly, there are indications that location data was deleted from their phones. Israeli Police Commissioner has ordered a command center to operate around the clock, 24/7, in Israel and abroad. Israeli security agencies have also joined the search and investigation. The investigation will now be led by Lahav 433, the Israeli police’s elite investigative division, which handles major organized crime, international and cross-border investigations and cases requiring advanced intelligence capabilities. LA JUSTICIA RESOLVIÓ QUE LA CAUSA POR LA CASAQUINTA DE PILAR VINCULADA A LA AFA REGRESE AL FUERO FEDERAL DE CAMPANA | Por Silvana Boschi y Karina Poritzker La Cámara Federal de Casación Penal resolvió este viernes que la causa por presunto lavado de activos que investiga si la casaquinta de Pilar, valuada en 17 millones de dólares, fue comprada por supuestos testaferros de dirigentes de la AFA, debe salir del fuero en lo penal económico de la ciudad de Buenos Aires y volver al juzgado federal de Campana a cargo de Adrián González Charvay. El máximo tribunal penal federal del país estableció que la investigación debe continuar en la justicia federal criminal y correccional, en resguardo de la garantía constitucional del juez natural “y de una buena y pronta administración de justicia”. Ordenó el envío del expediente a la Cámara Federal de Apelaciones de San Martín para que, “sin dilaciones”, lo remita otra vez al juzgado federal “de oportuna y previa intervención”, es decir, el de Campana a cargo de González Charvay. La decisión fue tomada por los jueces Mariano Borinsky y Diego Barroetaveña con disidencia de Alejandro Slokar, quien se pronunció por declarar el recurso “inadmisible” por motivos formales, no se trató de una sentencia definitiva ni equiparable a tal, aunque coincidió con sus colegas en que el lavado de activos es un delito que debe investigarse en el fuero federal y resulta ajeno al penal económico. La investigación por presunto lavado de dinero vinculada a esa propiedad de Pilar y otros bienes de lujo corresponde así al ámbito de la Justicia Federal, según el fallo de 83 carillas al que tuvo acceso Infobae. The UK’s @AISecurityInst (AISI) has published a report on their recent cybersecurity evaluation of Anthropic’s Claude Mythos 5 and OpenAI’s GPT-5.6 Sol. The models attempted to complete an assignment in a setup where their normal safeguards were removed and they were deliberately given internet access. AISI reports that the models “engaged in sustained, potentially harmful activity directed at real people and organisations”. We’re grateful to AISI for their leadership in the important discussion about how to evaluate increasingly capable AI agents. We’re working closely with them to gather more details of the incident as we conduct our own investigation. Gaining a clear picture of Claude’s understanding of its situation—by examining its reasoning transcripts and running our own analyses—will help us identify the causes of its behavior. The prompts in the evaluation did not impose any specific restrictions on how the internet should be used. This and the removal of safeguards meant that the models were tested under “deliberately permissive conditions” that are not representative of any of our production models. Note that there was no evidence here of an escape from a secure environment. AISI’s disclosure of the incident can be found here: aisi.gov.uk/blog/incident-re…

The Trump administration has asked the Supreme Court to allow construction of the White House’s $400 million ballroom to continue while it appeals a lower court ruling that halted the project, according to the Associated Press. The D.C. Circuit ruled 2-1 that Trump cannot proceed without congressional approval, finding that the president lacks unilateral authority to build the 90,000 square foot structure where the East Wing once stood. The administration argues the project is necessary for White House security, calling the injunction unlawful and warning that stopping construction would leave an active construction site that is harder to secure. The appeals court had exempted work necessary for White House safety. The Supreme Court is being asked to act before the lower court's ruling takes effect on Aug. 21. The administration says the project is already about 65% complete after 10 months of construction.

During World War II, the Marine Corps turned to a method of communication that Japanese intelligence could never crack: the Navajo language. In 1942, a group of Navajo Marines developed an unbreakable oral code that allowed for fast and secure communication during battles throughout the Pacific Theater of Operations. "We signed an MOU with Suzuki and Air India a few weeks ago to formally examine what kind of use case we can make or what kind of business we can do in India with eVTOL...," he told reporters here. Stating that SkyDrive has already done flight tests, with a speed of 100 kilometer per hour, more than 300 times and is now undergoing certification, Fukuzawa said, "In two years, we are planning to get certification and go for commercialisation, not just in Japan but also India." SkyDrive, which has signed an agreement with Suzuki for manufacturing of its flying car in Japan, is also open to have it produced in India in future, he said. The exhibition was organised by Mont Rose Foundation, in collaboration with Pakistan High Commission at the historic National Liberal Club #London, of which Mr. Jinnah remained a member. The exhibition displayed paintings of Quaid-e-Azam, created with water-colors, by artist Amera Rashid. The exhibition was attended by a large number of Mr. Jinnah’s admirers, both British and Pakistanis. In his key-note remarks, the High Commissioner stated that Jinnah firmly believed in the rule of law, reasoned argument, dialogue and political negotiation despite differences with opponents. Tipu Usman said that Jinnah’s legacy was not only about remembering the struggle that led to the creation of Pakistan but it was equally about understanding the principles and values that guided that struggle. The High Commissioner appreciated the efforts of Mr. Bilal Sheikh, CEO of Mont Rose Foundation for organizing the exhibition and also for commissioning a portrait of Quaid-e-Azam that is permanently placed in the National Liberal Club. Other speakers paid tributes to Muhammad Ali Jinnah’s legal acumen, democratic principles and the struggle that culminated in independence of Pakistan. NITI Aayog has released the report “Key Sectors to Position India as a Global Manufacturing Hub,” presenting a roadmap to strengthen India’s manufacturing ecosystem and advance the vision of Viksit Bharat 2047. The study assesses 62 manufacturing sectors and identifies 12 high-potential sectors where India can build scale, enhance competitiveness, create quality employment, and deepen integration with global value chains. The analysis draws on sectoral assessment, international benchmarking, and industry consultations. The identified sectors are: Automobiles, Chemicals, Capital Goods, Electronics, Pharmaceuticals, Defence & Drones, Food Processing, Textiles, Steel, Leather & Footwear, Telecom Equipment, and Solar PV Manufacturing. Volume I focuses on Chemicals, Textiles, Telecom & Network Equipment, and Solar PV Manufacturing, and provides sector-specific pathways to strengthen value addition, technology, and global competitiveness. 📖 Read the report: niti.gov.in/sites/default/fi… #GlobalManufacturingHub #ViksitBharat2047 @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

Dr. R. Balasubramaniam, Member, NITI Aayog, today released the Compendium on ITDP/ITDA Strengthening along with the Minister for Tribal Affairs, Shri Jual Oram and the Secretary of MoTA, Smt. Ranjana Chopra at Kartavya Bhavan, New Delhi. The compendium focuses on strengthening Integrated Tribal Development Projects (ITDPs) and Integrated Tribal Development Agencies (ITDAs), which play a key role in planning, implementing, and monitoring tribal development initiatives across the country. The initiative aims to support stronger institutional capacity, better convergence, improved implementation, and more effective delivery of development programmes for tribal communities, contributing to inclusive and sustainable development. #TribalDevelopment #ITDP #ITDA

NITI TARA (Toolkit for Analysis, Review & Action) continues to support evidence-based administrative action at the grassroots level. More than 250 capacity-building sessions have been conducted across the country, benefiting over 4500 district and block-level officials in the use of data-driven insights for governance. NITI TARA offers multi-sectoral dashboards, visualisation tools, and real-time planning features that assist in ground-level reviews and help translate data into timely action on the ground. A key component of the platform is AI SARTHI, an AI-based conversational tool integrated within NITI TARA and available on the NITI for States Portal. AI SARTHI uses verified government data to assist officials by helping identify root causes of local issues, highlighting field-level bottlenecks, and suggesting established best practices for faster resolution. As capacity-building activities continue to expand, NITI TARA aims to translate training into practical outcomes, supporting local administrators in delivering responsive and citizen-centric governance. ବର୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ସ୍ମାର୍ଟ ସିଟି ରାଉରକେଲାର ସହରାଞ୍ଚଳରେ ଦେଖାଦେଇଥିବା ଜଳବନ୍ଦୀ ସ୍ଥିତି ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଚିନ୍ତାର ବିଷୟ। ସହରବାସୀଙ୍କ ଧନଜୀବନ ପ୍ରତି ଏହା ବିପଦ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିଥିବା ବେଳେ, ସରକାରଙ୍କ ଅପାରଗତା ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ଅଧିକ ଭୟଭୀତ କରୁଛି। ସହରୀ ବନ୍ୟାରେ ଲୋକେ ଦୀର୍ଘ ଦିନ ଧରି ଜଳବନ୍ଦୀ ଜୀବନ ବଞ୍ଚୁଛନ୍ତି। ସରକାରୀ ସୁବିଧା ସେମାନଙ୍କ ନିକଟରେ ପହଞ୍ଚୁ ନଥିବାର ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଆସୁଛି। ଏପରି ଅସମୟରେ ଲୋକଙ୍କ ସାଥିରେ ସରକାର ଦୃଢ଼ ଭାବେ ଠିଆ ହେବା ବଦଳରେ ଲୋକଙ୍କ ହାତ ଛାଡ଼ିଦେଇଥିବା ପରି ମନେ ହେଉଛି। ଲୋକଙ୍କ କଥା ନ ଶୁଣି, ଲୋକଙ୍କ ସମସ୍ୟା ସମାଧାନ ନ କରି ସରକାର ଖାଲି ଦିବା ସ୍ୱପ୍ନ ଦେଖାଉଛନ୍ତି। ହକି ବିଶ୍ୱକପ ଆୟୋଜନ କରି ଯେଉଁ ରାଉରକେଲା ସ୍ମାର୍ଟ ସିଟି ଗୌରବ ଆଣିଥିଲା, ଏବେ ସେହି ସହର ଜଳବନ୍ଦୀ ହୋଇ ଅପବାଦ ମୁଣ୍ଡାଉଛି। ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଏପରି ସ୍ଥିତି କେବେ ଦେଖା ଦେଇନଥିବା ବେଳେ ଏବେ ସ୍ମାର୍ଟ ସିଟିର ଡ୍ରେନେଜ୍ ଓ ସ୍ବେରେଜ୍ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବିପର୍ଯ୍ୟସ୍ତ ହୋଇପଡ଼ିଛି। ଦିନେ ବଡ଼ ବଡ଼ ପ୍ରାକୃତିକ ବିପର୍ଯ୍ୟୟର ଦୃଢ଼ ମୁକାବିଲା କରି ଓଡ଼ିଶା ସୁନାମ ସାଉଁଟୁଥିଲା, ହେଲେ ଏ ସରକାର ସହରାଞ୍ଚଳରେ ବର୍ଷା ଜଳ ପରିଚାଳନାରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ବିଫଳ ହେଉଛନ୍ତି। ପ୍ରତିଟି ଜୀବନ ମୂଲ୍ୟବାନ, ସରକାର ତୁରନ୍ତ ପ୍ରାଥମିକତା ଭିତ୍ତିରେ ଜଳବନ୍ଦୀରେ ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ସମସ୍ତ ପ୍ରକାର ସରକାରୀ ସହାୟତା ଯୋଗାଇ ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ। #BJDWithOdisha

With grave concern, I bring to the attention of Hon’ble Chief Minister Shri @MohanMOdisha ji about the recent passage of the Mines and Minerals (Development and Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026 by Parliament. This legislation poses a serious threat to #Odisha's fiscal autonomy and constitutional rights over its natural resources. The provisions introduced in this Bill will disproportionately impact mineral-rich states like Odisha, leading to massive revenue losses and stifling our state's developmental agenda. The Amendment raises critical concerns through the provisions: Encroachment of State Land and Fiscal Jurisdiction, Restriction on State Revenue Powers and Delegation of Power to the Centre. Odisha's natural wealth belongs to her people, and the revenue generated from mining operations is crucial for financing healthcare, education, social welfare schemes, and infrastructure development across the state. By stripping the state of its power to impose taxes and cesses on its own mineral-bearing lands, the Union Government has dealt a heavy blow to federalism and state revenue autonomy. Given the gravity of this situation and its long-term adverse implications for Odisha's economy, I strongly urge Shri Majhi to convene an All-Party Meeting immediately to build a unified consensus on safeguarding Odisha's federal rights and mineral revenues. Urge you to summon a Special Session of the Odisha Legislative Assembly to formally pass a unanimous Resolution opposing this Amendment Act and protesting the Union Government's usurpation of state powers. Fiscal autonomy is a constitutional principle built into our federal system. This Bill directly undermines a critical pillar of the Centre-State relationship, taking India's federal structure in a distinctly retrogressive direction and striking at the foundation of cooperative federalism. This issue transcends political affiliations, as it directly impacts the financial stability and future growth of Odisha. If the Central Government takes away the State's authority over mineral-bearing lands and its right to levy cesses, only pollution, displacement and burden of mining will remain with Odisha, while the benefits are taken away from its people. I hope you will act swiftly in the paramount interest of the people of Odisha.

What’s the difference between a rock and a mineral? 🪨 We’ve all picked up an interesting rock at some point, but what looks like a single rock may be made up of several different minerals. Think of minerals as the pieces, and rocks as the puzzle they make. A mineral is a naturally occurring, non-living, solid substance with its own unique chemical makeup and structure. Common minerals include quartz, feldspar, mica, olivine, and calcite. A rock, on the other hand, is a mix of one or more minerals bound together. Granite, basalt, limestone, and sandstone are all rocks made up of different mineral combinations. USGS scientists study the mineral content of rocks and map them across the U.S. to understand where valuable mineral deposits might be found, information that helps meet the needs of modern manufacturing, technology, and energy production. Our scientists also study how rocks form and change over time, piecing together the story of our planet's 4.5-billion-year history. Discover more about the rocks and minerals that shape our world and how USGS studies them at ow.ly/iKA550ZzxSA 📸1: Vertical columns of basaltic volcanic rock, like those at Devils Postpile National Monument in California, are formed when think lava flows slowly cool. 📸2: A sample of azurite, the blue mineral, and malachite, the green mineral from Milpillas Mine, Mexico. Both azurite and malachite are copper minerals that were once used as pigments. They serve as good indicators of copper deposits that can be developed. 📸3: Silicon Carbide’s primary commodity is silica, an abrasive. Just as their name implies, abrasives are used to abrade, clean, etch, grind, polish, scour, or otherwise remove material. 📸4: A fluorite mineral set in surrounding rock. Flourspar, the processed form of fluorite, is used directly or indirectly to manufacture products such as aluminum, gasoline, insulating foams, refrigerants, steel, and uranium fuel. Nahar Aspirational Block in Rewari district, Haryana, is strengthening efforts to address Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) through Mission SAMarth, a focused initiative built on convergence, community participation, and sustained nutritional support. The initiative brings together the Health and Women & Child Development Departments, Anganwadi Workers, ASHA workers, Panchayats, and families to ensure regular growth monitoring of SAM children, home-based counselling, promotion of breastfeeding, timely micronutrient supplementation, and access to supplementary nutrition. This coordinated approach is helping ensure that every identified child receives continuous care, nutrition, and support for healthy growth. स्वातंत्र्यवीरांच्या त्यागाला तिरंग्याच्या सन्मानातून मानवंदना! मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या प्रमुख उपस्थितीत आज छत्रपती संभाजीनगर येथे 'हर घर तिरंगा अभियान' अंतर्गत तिरंगा रॅली संपन्न झाली. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस म्हणाले, तिरंगा हा देशाची आन, बान आणि शान असून, या तिरंग्यासाठी हजारो स्वातंत्र्यसैनिकांनी आपल्या प्राणांचे बलिदान दिले आहे. तिरंगा ही देशाची ओळख, अस्तित्व आणि आत्माभिमान आहे. 9 ऑगस्ट रोजी महात्मा गांधी यांनी 'भारत छोडो' आंदोलनाची हाक देत 'करो या मरो'चा संदेश दिला होता. 9 ऑगस्ट ते 15 ऑगस्ट या कालावधीत तिरंग्याचा सन्मान करण्यासाठी ही तिरंगा यात्रा काढण्यात येत असून विक्रमी प्रतिसाद मिळालेली छत्रपती संभाजीनगरमधील आजची तिरंगा यात्रा मातृभूमीच्या प्रेमाने ओतप्रोत आहे. पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांच्या नेतृत्वाखाली गेल्या दशकात भारताने अभूतपूर्व विकास साध्य केला आहे. जग आज भारताकडे एक बलशाली देश आणि जगातील चौथी मोठी अर्थव्यवस्था म्हणून पाहत आहे. चंद्राच्या दक्षिण ध्रुवावर यान उतरविणारा जगातील पहिला देश होण्याचा मान भारताला मिळाला असून, ही प्रत्येक भारतीयासाठी अभिमानाची बाब आहे. महाराष्ट्रातही मोठे परिवर्तन होत असून, मराठवाडा विकास आणि परिवर्तनाच्या वाटेवर आहे. पुढील पिढीला दुष्काळाचा सामना करावा लागू नये, यासाठी दुष्काळमुक्त मराठवाड्याच्या दिशेने वाटचाल सुरू आहे. कोकणातून वाहून जाणारे पाणी गोदावरीच्या खोऱ्यात, तसेच सांगली आणि कोल्हापूरचे पाणी उजनीच्या माध्यमातून मराठवाड्यात आणून मराठवाड्याला सुजलाम्-सुफलाम् करणार असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. आज भारतातील तरुणाई स्टार्टअपच्या माध्यमातून विविध क्षेत्रांत जागतिक पातळीवर आपला ठसा उमटवत आहे. भारत प्रत्येक क्षेत्रात प्रगती करत आहे. स्वातंत्र्यदिन हा केवळ देशाला मिळालेल्या स्वातंत्र्याचे स्मरण करण्याचा दिवस नसून, महामानव, भारतरत्न डॉ. बाबासाहेब आंबेडकर यांनी संविधानात नमूद केलेली मूलभूत कर्तव्येही स्मरणात ठेवण्याचा दिवस आहे. मराठवाड्याच्या स्वातंत्र्याच्या इतिहासाचा उल्लेख करताना त्यांनी सांगितले की, भारताला स्वातंत्र्य मिळाल्यानंतर मराठवाड्याला तब्बल 13 महिने स्वातंत्र्यासाठी संघर्ष करावा लागला. 17 सप्टेंबर 1948 रोजी निजामाच्या राजवटीतून मराठवाडा मुक्त झाला. स्वातंत्र्यसैनिकांच्या त्याग आणि बलिदानामुळे आज मराठवाड्याला मुक्तपणे श्वास घेता येत आहे. या भूमीसाठी बलिदान देणाऱ्या स्वातंत्र्यसैनिकांना अभिवादन करून, तिरंग्याचा सन्मान राखत विकसित, समृद्ध महाराष्ट्राचा संकल्प करत आपण पुढे जाऊया, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी केले. यावेळी विधानपरिषदेचे सभापती प्रा. राम शिंदे, मंत्री गिरीष महाजन, मंत्री अतुल सावे, मंत्री राधाकृष्ण विखे पाटील, मंत्री पंकजा मुंडे, मंत्री संजय सावकारे, खासदार अशोक चव्हाण, आमदार रविंद्र चव्हाण यांच्यासह इतर मान्यवर उपस्थित होते. @narendramodi @Dev_Fadnavis @Prof_RamShinde @girishdmahajan @RVikhePatil For participating farmers, stronger market access has helped increase their incomes by more than 50%. This is where development finance can make a difference. Investing across the value chain to connect producers with finance, infrastructure, standards and buyers, and enable them to compete in higher-value markets. Working with the Government of Cambodia and the private sector is central to making those connections last. Public investment can strengthen the conditions for growth, while businesses bring demand, market knowledge and long-term commercial relationships. These partnerships work both ways. Farmers gain more predictable demand and stronger bargaining power, while buyers gain the quality, traceability and reliable supply they need. At scale, stronger market connections can help rural producers capture more value and support Cambodia’s shift towards higher-value agricultural exports. Mastering high-speed drones for effective surveillance and strike capabilities has been a common lesson for modern defence preparedness from recent wars such as Operation Sindoor, the Iran War and the Ukraine War. What is India doing as a result? - DRDO-led Ghatak program has been India's response to this challenge, which will depend on Dry Kaveri Derivative Engines to power drones to transonic speeds. - Ghatak is a 13-tonne-class autonomous stealth Unmanned Combat Aerial Vehicle (UCAV) designed for high-subsonic speeds and capable of matching low transonic speeds, with initial engine production underway. - Transonic UCAVs operate at high-subsonic to low-supersonic speeds (approximately Mach 0.8 to Mach 1.2). - Autonomous flight controls, engine, stealth airframe materials, composite structure and internal weapons bay are key parts of such drones. Only Autonomous flight controls are where India has mastery at the moment. The rest of the capabilities are still emerging; engine capabilities will be decisive. - 49-52 kN Dry Kaveri Derivative Engine is not yet fully developed, but Ghatak aims to use it to fly UCAVs up to altitudes of 30000 to 35000 feet and speeds up to 0.9 Mach, matching the transonic range. Godrej Aerospace is involved with GTRE as a production partner for these engines. @indiaBUILDwiki

An Italian Eurofighter assigned to NATO’s Baltic Air Policing mission shot down a drone of unconfirmed, but likely Russian origin after it entered Latvian airspace Friday, according to NATO and Latvian authorities. Two Italian Eurofighters scrambled from Lithuania along with two Turkish F-16s from Estonia. One of the Italian jets identified and engaged the drone. Latvian forces are now searching for the wreckage near Rugāji, about 35 km from the Russian border, so the drone’s origin has not yet been established. The incident comes amid a growing number of drone incursions into Baltic airspace. Latvia says Ukrainian drones have entered the region several times this year, while officials also point to Russian electronic warfare as a possible factor causing Ukrainian systems to stray across borders. Before Friday's incident, Ukrainian forces had launched attacks against Russian ports near St. Petersburg. Russian authorities claimed to have intercepted 15 Ukrainian drones during those attacks. This is the third reported NATO interception of a drone in the Baltics in recent months, following a Romanian F-16 shootdown in Estonia in May and a French Rafale shootdown in Latvia in June.

कल नेता प्रतिपक्ष राहुल गांधी जी ने प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेन्द्र मोदी जी एवं भारत की विदेश नीति पर जो टिप्पणी की है, वो अत्यन्त निम्नस्तरीय और निन्दाजनक तो है ही, साथ ही मुझे व्यक्तिगत रूप से बहुत पीड़ा देने वाली भी है। अपने लम्बे राजनैतिक जीवन में, मैंने किसी भी नेता प्रतिपक्ष को, चाहे वो सुषमा जी या अरूण जेटलीजी रहे हो, अथवा अटल जी और आडवाणी जी रहे हो, या फिर अटलजी की सरकार में डॉ. मनमोहन सिंह हों या सोनिया गांधी जी रही हो, ऐसा अशोभनीय आचरण कल्पना से परे था। ऐसा आचरण भारत में स्वस्थ्य लोकतंत्र के लिए, एक गंभीर खतरे का संकेत है। राहुल गांधी जी के मन में, प्रधानमंत्री जी के प्रति चाहे जितनी भी कुण्ठा भरी हो, ऐसी अभद्र टिप्पणी सर्वथा अस्वीकार्य है। विशेषकर तब जबकि मोदीजी के रूप में एक ऐसे प्रधानमंत्री, जिन्होंने अंतर्राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर भारत का मान बढ़ाया और विकसित भारत का मार्ग प्रशस्त किया, ऐसे नेता के प्रति ऐसी अभद्र टिप्पणी, हर भारतीय के मन को, अन्दर से कष्ट देने वाली है। मैं कांग्रेस पार्टी से यह भी कहना चाहूंगा, कि ऐसी भाषा और आचरण के बाद, क्या वे लोग अब, लाल, बाल, पाल से लेकर गांधीजी नेहरूजी, सरदार पटेल, सुभाष बाबू, राजेन्द्र बाबू से लेकर शास्त्री जी, नरसिम्हा राव जी से लेकर प्रणव मुखर्जी जी तक जैसे विराट व्यक्तित्वों की विरासत का दावा कर सकते हैं? मैं कह सकता हूं कि, आज इस आचरण से राहुल गांधी ने न सिर्फ प्रधानमंत्री मोदीजी का अपमान किया है बल्कि भारत की अंतर्राष्ट्रीय प्रतिष्ठा का अपमान किया है, लोकतंत्र और नेता प्रतिपक्ष के पद की गरिमा को तार-तार कर दिया है। मैं तो यह कल्पना भी नही कर सकता कि जिसके नाम के आगे गांधी शब्द लगा हो, वह ऐसा शर्मनाक बयान दे सकता है! VIDEO | Amstelveen (The Netherlands): Ahead of the Indian men's hockey team's World Cup-opening clash against Wales at the FIH Hockey World Cup on Sunday, India chief coach Craig Fulton says, “I think that's pretty straightforward. Wales are the complete underdogs, and that's what the World Cup is about sometimes. You've got to play according to your seeding, and against every team ranked below you, you really have to concentrate and put in a full effort. We take nothing for granted, so we're expecting a tough battle from them. At the same time, we need to put 100 per cent focus and attention on our game plan, not worry too much about them, and make sure we deliver four consistent quarters with good pressure. It's really important. Our emphasis is on the first game and making sure we hit the ground running. It's important to get those three points. I think it's about national pride. We want to make the nation proud on Independence Day and start the tournament well. So it's a good omen. It's just one game at a time. We can't look beyond the match in front of us. We have the first game, and we want to do a good job with our preparation. From there, we make sure we are ready to play the next challenge.” Video

Haridwar: Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami paid tribute in Haridwar on Partition Horrors Remembrance Day to the sons and daughters of Bharat Mata who endured the unbearable trauma of the Partition of 1947. On the occasion, the Chief Minister said that the line drawn across the heart of India was not merely a division of geography, but a partition of the lives, identities, and dreams of millions of people. The pain of displacement and the horrors witnessed during that period are difficult to put into words. The nation can never forget such a tragic chapter in its history. The Chief Minister said it was unfortunate that the hunger for power among the then Congress leadership and the political ambitions of one family pushed the country towards such a tragic Partition. Millions suffered its consequences, and generations continued to pay the price. He said remembering those decisions on Partition Horrors Remembrance Day is essential so that lessons can be drawn from history and the resolve to give the highest priority to the unity, integrity, and social harmony of the country can be strengthened.

The cuisine, featuring dishes like Macher Jhol, Kosha Mangsho, Phuchka, Mishti Doi reflects a blend of tradition and flavour. Whether it is exploring its cultural landmarks, experiencing its festivals, or enjoying its natural beauty, West Bengal offers a journey that is vibrant and enriching. Har Ghar Tiranga: 27 Field Ammunition Depot Plants 5,000 Saplings in Kanasar, Launches Anti-Drug Awareness Drive As India prepares to celebrate its 80th Independence Day, 27 Field Ammunition Depot (27 FAD), Kanasar, under the aegis of 81 Headquarters Sub Area, organised a massive plantation and anti-drug awareness programme under the Har Ghar Tiranga campaign. Led by Colonel Poonam Sangwan, VSM, Commandant 27 FAD, the initiative saw active participation from Army personnel, families and students from Sobasar and Kanasar schools. Around 5,000 saplings, including Khejri, Neem, Shisham, Fig, Gulmohar, Gundi and Keshamal, were planted, with a focus on species suited to Bikaner’s harsh arid climate. The programme also featured a Nasha Mukt Bharat awareness session, a ‘Know Your Army’ initiative and messages on environmental conservation, healthy living and responsible citizenship. Environmentalist Prof. Shyam Sundar Jyani, BDA Deputy Commissioner Kunal Rahar and National Research Centre on Camel Director Dr Anil Kumar Poonia also participated, highlighting the importance of protecting the environment and empowering the youth. Thiruvananthapuram: Keralam government has decided to implement the ‘Kerala Flood Resilience Initiative’ to scientifically address the impact of climate change and natural disasters, including heavy rainfall and floods in Kerala. A team of experts from various IITs met Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan as part of the initiative. Experts from IIT Roorkee, IIT Palakkad and IIIT Kottayam presented a comprehensive framework for developing a state-of-the-art flood resilience system using advanced technologies, with the aim of creating a model that could be replicated across the country. The expert team recommended scientific preparedness to tackle extreme rainfall, urban flooding, riverine floods, landslides and other natural disasters. The initiative proposes the use of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, remote sensing, hydrodynamic modelling and high-precision rainfall forecasting systems to identify flood-prone areas in advance and issue accurate early warnings. The IIT team also pointed out that any measures to remove silt and sediment from rivers, lakes and backwaters should be undertaken only after scientifically assessing their impact on the environment and natural water flow. The Chief Minister directed the Water Resources Department and Disaster Management Department to conduct a detailed assessment of the project’s technical feasibility, financial implications and implementation mechanisms. The two departments have been asked to jointly examine the proposal and submit a report within one month. Further steps towards implementing the initiative in the state will be taken based on this report. A high-level meeting was attended by Revenue Minister A.P. Anilkumar, Environment Minister Sunny Joseph, Agriculture Minister T. Siddique, Water Resources Minister Mons Joseph and Chief Secretary Bishwanath Sinha IAS, among others. (Pics: Keralam CMO)

صحت مند مائیں، صحت مند بچے ایک صحت مند اور مضبوط پاکستان کی بنیاد ہیں 🇵🇰🇵🇰 چیئرمین سینیٹ سید یوسف رضا گیلانی نے کہا ہے کہ ماؤں اور بچوں کی صحت و بہبود قومی ترقی کی بنیادی ضرورت ہے، جبکہ ماں، نومولود اور بچوں کی صحت پر سرمایہ کاری دراصل پاکستان کے انسانی سرمائے اور مستقبل میں سرمایہ کاری ہے۔ سید یوسف رضا گیلانی ماں، نومولود اور بچوں کی صحت سے متعلق سماجی و رویوں میں تبدیلی کے ابلاغی مہم کے آغاز کی تقریب سے بطور مہمانِ خصوصی خطاب کرتے ہوئے وزارتِ قومی صحت خدمات، ضوابط و رابطہ اور یونیسیف پاکستان کو مبارکباد دی اور ترقیاتی شراکت داروں، طبی ماہرین، شعبۂ تعلیم و تحقیق اور سول سوسائٹی کی کاوشوں کو سراہا۔ سید یوسف رضا گیلانی نے کہا کہ صحت مند مائیں اور بچے مضبوط خاندانوں، باصلاحیت و فعال معاشروں اور ایک مضبوط و پائیدار پاکستان کی بنیاد ہیں۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ پاکستان نے صحت کے اہم اشاریوں میں نمایاں پیش رفت کی ہے، جس کے نتیجے میں شیر خوار بچوں کی شرحِ اموات کم ہو کر فی ایک ہزار زندہ پیدائشوں پر 47 اور زچگی کے دوران اموات کی شرح بہتر ہو کر فی ایک لاکھ زندہ پیدائشوں پر 186 ہو گئی ہے۔ تاہم، ماؤں اور نومولود بچوں کو بروقت، معیاری اور قابلِ استطاعت طبی سہولیات کی فراہمی کے حوالے سے اب بھی اہم چیلنجز درپیش ہیں۔ نئی شروع کی جانے والی مہم کو اجاگر کرتے ہوئے چیئرمین سینیٹ نے کہا کہ اس مہم کے ذریعے تین ایسے سادہ مگر زندگی بچانے والے رویوں کی حوصلہ افزائی کی جا رہی ہے جن میں حمل کے دوران بروقت طبی معائنہ، ماہر اور تربیت یافتہ عملے کی موجودگی میں زچگی اور نومولود کی ضروری نگہداشت شامل ہیں۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ درست معلومات اگر درست وقت پر فراہم کی جائیں تو قیمتی انسانی جانیں بچائی جا سکتی ہیں۔ چیئرمین سینیٹ نے زور دیا کہ عوامی آگاہی کے ساتھ ساتھ معیاری طبی سہولیات، تربیت یافتہ طبی عملہ، مؤثر ریفرل نظام اور قابلِ استطاعت علاج کی فراہمی بھی یقینی بنانا ضروری ہے۔ انہوں نے حاملہ اور دودھ پلانے والی خواتین اور بچوں کے لیے بالخصوص زندگی کے ابتدائی ایک ہزار دنوں کی اہمیت اجاگر کرتے ہوئے بینظیر نشوونما پروگرام جیسے اقدامات کو بھی سراہا۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ زچہ و بچہ کی صحت سے متعلق پالیسی سازی، قانون سازی اور مؤثر نگرانی کو مضبوط بنانے میں پارلیمان کا اہم کردار ہے۔ اس ضمن میں دور دراز اور پسماندہ علاقوں میں رہنے والی خواتین اور بچوں کے ساتھ ساتھ غربت، بے گھر ہونے اور موسمیاتی تبدیلی سے پیدا ہونے والی ہنگامی صورتحال سے متاثرہ افراد کی ضروریات پر خصوصی توجہ دینا ناگزیر ہے۔ چیئرمین سینیٹ বিয়ের গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অনুষঙ্গ দেনমোহর। এটি স্ত্রীর অধিকার। স্বামীর তা পরিশোধ করা ইসলামের বিধান। এটি কেবল একটা অঙ্ক ধরে রাখার নাম নয়; বরং তা পরিশোধ করা স্বামীর জন্য ওয়াজিব। বিস্তারিত : দেনমোহর সম্পূর্ণ নারীর অধিকার। এ অধিকার খর্ব করা যাবে না। মহান আল্লাহ বলেন, وَ الۡمُحۡصَنٰتُ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنٰتِ وَ الۡمُحۡصَنٰتُ مِنَ الَّذِیۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡکِتٰبَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِکُمۡ اِذَاۤ اٰتَیۡتُمُوۡهُنَّ اُجُوۡرَهُنَّ مُحۡصِنِیۡنَ غَیۡرَ مُسٰفِحِیۡنَ وَ لَا مُتَّخِذِیۡۤ اَخۡدَانٍ অর্থ: আর মুমিন সচ্চরিত্রা নারী ও তোমাদের আগে যাদেরকে কিতাব দেয়া হয়েছে, তাদের মধ্যে সচ্চরিত্রা নারীদের তোমাদের জন্য বৈধ করা হলো। যদি তোমরা তাদের দেনমোহর দাও বিয়ের জন্য, প্রকাশ্য ব্যভিচার বা গোপন প্রণয়িনী গ্রহণকারী হিসেবে নয়। (সুরা মায়েদা. আয়াত : ৫) যা পাত্রী ও পাত্রপক্ষের আলোচনা সাপেক্ষে নির্ধারিত হয়। বর্তমান সমাজে এই দেনমোহর নির্ধারণে একচেটিয়া সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে দেখা যায়। দেনমোহরের সর্বোচ্চ পরিমাণ নির্ধারিত নয়। তবে সর্বনিম্ন পরিমাণ নির্ধারিত। সর্বনিম্ন পরিমাণের কমে দেনমোহর ধার্য করা যাবে না। অনেকে নিজেকে খুব বেশি উদার প্রমাণ করার জন্য দেনমোহর ছাড়াই বিয়ে করেন। এটা খামখেয়ালিপনা। ইসলামি শরিয়তের বিধান হলো- বিয়েতে সর্বনিম্ন দেনমোহর ১০ দিরহাম। অর্থাৎ ৩০.৬১৮ গ্রাম রুপা। ১০ দিরহামের কম পরিমাণ দেনমোহর নির্ধারণে স্ত্রী রাজি হলেও তা শরিয়তের দৃষ্টিতে বৈধ হবে না। নবীজি সাল্লাহল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লাম বলেন, ১০ দিরহামের কম কোনো দেনমোহর নেই।’ বায়হাকি শরীফ, ৭/২৪০)। বাজারের তারতম্যের ভিত্তিতে পৌনে তিন ভরি খাঁটি রুপার মূল্য যখন যে হারে হয়- দেনমোহরের সর্বনিম্ন মূল্যও তখন তা হবে। স্ত্রীর বংশ ও তার সমমানের নারীদের দেনমোহরের পরিমাণ বিবেচনা করাও উচিত। (বাদায়েউস সানায়ে : ২য় খণ্ড, ২৭৫ পৃষ্ঠা)। যদি কোনো বিয়ে এমন হয় যে, যেখানে দেনমোহর উল্লেখ করা হয়নি কিংবা দেনমোহর দেয়া হবে না এই শর্ত করা হয়, তাহলে ওই শর্ত বাতিল হবে এবং ওই বিয়েতেও স্বামীর ওপর স্ত্রীকে দেনমোহর আদায় করা আবশ্যক হবে। এ ক্ষেত্রে অবশ্য সর্বনিম্ন পরিমাণ দেনমোহর নয়; During the Working Visit, Dr. Kao will engage with a wide range of high-ranking government officials and key stakeholders, including the Minister of Foreign Affairs, the Minister of Mines and Energy, the Minister of Sports, the Minister of Science, Technology and Innovation, the Minister of Development, Industry, Trade and Services, the President of the Brazilian Trade and Investment Promotion Agency, the President of the Federal Supreme Court, and the President of the Brazilian Agricultural Research Corporation, among many others. As part of his efforts to promote ASEAN’s profile and visibility, Dr. Kao will deliver a lecture on “ASEAN Regionalism: Overcoming Challenges and Building a Community,” at the Institute of International Relations of the University of Brasilia. In addition, Dr. Kao is also scheduled to meet with the ASEAN Committee in Brasilia, where he would brief the Committee on the latest development on the work of ASEAN and discuss the current state and future direction of ASEAN-Brazil Sectoral Dialogue Partnership, as well as exchange views on the Committee’s role in advancing ASEAN-Brazil relations. The Working Visit of the Secretary-General of ASEAN to Brazil this time will be an important opportunity to promote the ASEAN-Brazil Sectoral Dialogue Partnership by highlighting positive engagements between ASEAN and Brazil and reaffirming their shared commitment to further strengthening cooperation in the years ahead.

In rural Morocco, cooperatives are turning saffron into a driver of local transformation, capturing more value, creating jobs and keeping economic activity in the community. Through a partnership between IFAD and the Government of Morocco, saffron cultivation was introduced to the Azilal region and supported through several cooperatives working with local farmers. Among them, the Ait Bouali cooperative has brought together 184 farmers and helped build a local enterprise that employs dozens of people year-round. What began with just 17 hectares has expanded to more than 300 hectares, generating up to US$2,500 per hectare, far beyond what traditional crops could offer. The project also delivered measurable results across the region, with local incomes increasing by nearly 24%, poverty falling by 18% and almost 70% of supported farms boosting productivity by 20% or more. By supporting cooperatives and local value chains, IFAD and the Government of Morocco enabled small-scale producers to move into higher-value markets while creating employment and broader benefits for rural communities. 1947ء کو ہمیں ایسی سر زمین میسر ہوئی جہاں ہم آزاد قوم کی حیثیت سے عزت و وقار اور دین و تہذیبی اقدار کے مطابق زندگی استوار کر سکیں۔ سرزمینِ پاکستان اسلامی تعلیمات اور باباۓ قوم کے نظریات کے تابع تمام شہریوں کے لئے بلا تفریقِ رنگ و نسل مکمل آزادی کی ضمانت ہے۔ آئین و قوانینِ پاکستان تمام شہریوں کے حقوق کے ضامن ہیں۔ آزاد مملکت کی ترقی و خوشحالی کا یہ سفر اللہ تعالیٰ کے فضل و کرم سے آزمائشوں کے باوجود تابناک مستقبل کی جانب گامزن ہے۔ اہل وطن نے گزشتہ تمام ترمشکلات کے باوجود ہر شعبہ زندگی میں اپنی خداداد صلاحیتوں کی بدولت کامیابیاں سمیٹیں۔ دفاع وطن، معیشت، صنعت و حرفت، عدلیہ، میڈیا، کھیل، تعلیم و ہنر، علماء، دانشور، اساتذہ، سائنسدان، زراعت و کاشتکاری بشمول عصر حاضر کے جدید شعبہ جات میں پاکستانی مرد و خواتین نے اپنی کاوشوں سے عزم وہمت کے باب رقم کئے۔ ہمارے باصلاحیت نوجوان، ہنر مند افرادی قوت، بہترین پیشہ ور ماہرین، جفا کش کسان اور محنت کش مزدور ملک و قوم کے تابندہ مستقبل کے ضامن ہیں۔ حکومت پاکستان نے گزشتہ ڈھائی سالوں میں نہایت مشکل مراحل عبور کر کے مستحکم معیشت کا ہدف حاصل کیا ہے اور اب ترقی یافتہ معیشت کی منزل کی جانب کامیابی سے گامزن ہے۔ جدید انفارمیشن ٹیکنالوجی سے لیس، جدت سے آراستہ دیر پا صنعتی و زرعی ترقی، عوامی فلاح وبہبود کے منصوبے، روزگار کے مواقع، عالمی معیار کا تعلیم وہنر کا نظام ہماری اولین ترجیحات میں شامل ہیں۔ ہماری بہادر افواج نے ہر مشکل میں، دشمن کے ہر وار کے جواب میں مادر وطن کے دفاع کو ناقابلِ تسخیر ثابت کیا ہے۔پاکستان اپنی جری افواج پر فخر کرتا ہے۔ معرکۂ حق میں مسلح افواج نے،فیلڈ مارشل سید عاصم منیر کی قیادت میں اتحاد، عزم اور بے مثال بہادری کا مظاہرہ کرتے ہوئے وطنِ عزیز کے دفاع اور سربلندی کی نئی تاریخ رقم کی۔ پاکستان اپنے دفاع اور آبی وسائل سمیت قومی مفادات کے تحفظ کے لئے کسی قربانی سے دریغ نہیں کرے گا۔ آج پاکستان اقوام عالم میں ایک مضبوط، پُرعزم، باوقار اور امن کی توانا آواز کے طور پہچانا جاتا ہے۔ خطے کی مشکل اور چیلنجنگ علاقائی صورتحال میں پاکستان ایک ذمہ دار اور خطے میں استحکام کا ضامن ملک بن کر ابھرا ہے، جو امن، استحکام اور علاقائی تعاون کے فروغ میں تعمیری کردار ادا کر رہا ہے۔ پاکستان، سعودی عرب اور ترکیہ کے مابین مکہ مکرمہ میں طے پانے والا مشترکہ دفاعی معاہدہ خطے میں پاکستان کے بڑھتے ہوئے تزویراتی کردار اور ابھرتی ہوئی قوت کا اہم مظہر ہے۔ پاکستان، مظلوم فلسطینی عوام اور جموں و کشمیر کے اپنے بہنوں اور بھائیوں سے مکمل اظہار یکجہتی کرتا ہے اور انکے لئے اپنی غیر متزلزل اصولی حمایت کا اعادہ کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں پائیدار امن کی ضمانت جموں وکشمیر کے اقوام متحدہ کی قراردادوں کے مطابق، عالمی قوانین اور کشمیریوں کی امنگوں کے বুরুন্ডির পেনত্রা বুশিমা আমিনের ইসলাম গ্রহণের গল্পের শুরু মাত্র ১৪ বছর বয়সে। এক মুসলিম বন্ধু তাকে ইসলাম সম্পর্কে জানার আমন্ত্রণ জানান এবং ইসলামি মূল্যবোধ, নৈতিকতা ও গুণাবলির সঙ্গে পরিচয় করিয়ে দেন। ইসলামের শিক্ষা তাকে গভীরভাবে নাড়া দেয়। একপর্যায়ে তিনি ইসলাম গ্রহণের সিদ্ধান্ত নেন। পরিবারের সদস্যদের উপস্থিতিতেই তিনি ইসলাম গ্রহণ করেন। পরে তার বাবা-মা ও বোনসহ পরিবারের আরো চার সদস্য ইসলাম গ্রহণ করেন। ইসলাম গ্রহণের পর পবিত্র কুরআন শেখার যাত্রা শুরু করতে দেরি করেননি পেনত্রা। দৃঢ় সংকল্প ও আন্তরিক আগ্রহ নিয়ে তিনি কুরআন হিফজ করা শুরু করেন। মাত্র পাঁচ মাসের মধ্যেই তিনি সম্পূর্ণ কুরআন হিফজ করতে সক্ষম হন। #QuranHifz #NewMuslim #Islam #somoytv

ডারউইন টেস্টে অস্ট্রেলিয়ার বিপক্ষে দারুণ দাপট দেখাচ্ছে বাংলাদেশ। প্রথম ইনিংসে স্বাগতিকদের মাত্র ১৯৮ রানে অলআউট করে ব্যাট হাতে ইতোমধ্যে একশ রানের বেশি লিড নিয়ে নিয়েছে নাজমুল হোসেন শান্তর দল। বাংলাদেশের এই লড়াকু পারফরম্যান্সের অন্যতম নায়ক তানজিদ হাসান তামিম। ক্যারিয়ারের প্রথম টেস্ট সেঞ্চুরি তুলে নিয়ে ১০২ রানের দুর্দান্ত ইনিংস খেলেছেন তিনি। মুমিনুল হক ৪৯ রান করে অল্পের জন্য ফিফটি মিস করলেও দলের বড় সংগ্রহ গড়ার পথে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অবদান রেখেছেন। অধিনায়ক শান্তও ব্যাট হাতে দৃঢ়তা দেখিয়ে সেঞ্চুরির খুব কাছে গিয়ে আউট হন। বাংলাদেশের এমন পারফরম্যান্স নজর এড়ায়নি ভারতের সাবেক স্পিনার রবিচন্দ্রন অশ্বিনেরও। সামাজিক যোগাযোগমাধ্যম এক্সে বাংলাদেশের প্রশংসা করে তিনি লিখেছেন, ‘বাংলাদেশ ডারউইনে অস্ট্রেলিয়াকে ব্যাকফুটে ঠেলে দিয়েছে, এটা কারো চিত্রনাট্যে ছিল না।’ অশ্বিন আরও মনে করিয়ে দিয়েছেন, প্রস্তুতি ম্যাচে মাত্র ৫৪ রানে অলআউট হওয়ার পর বাংলাদেশের এই ঘুরে দাঁড়ানো সত্যিই উল্লেখযোগ্য। তার মতে, টেস্টের প্রথম দুই দিনেই অস্ট্রেলিয়ার বিপক্ষে বাংলাদেশের আধিপত্য দেখানো দারুণ এক পরিবর্তনের গল্প। বাংলাদেশের এমন পারফরম্যান্সকে টেস্ট ক্রিকেটের জন্যও ইতিবাচক হিসেবে দেখছেন অশ্বিন। তার মন্তব্য, ‘এই ফরম্যাট আরও অনেকদিন বেঁচে থাকুক।’ এখন বাংলাদেশের লক্ষ্য, দ্বিতীয় ইনিংসেও ব্যাটিংয়ের এই ধারাবাহিকতা ধরে রেখে লিড আরও বড় করা এবং অস্ট্রেলিয়াকে চাপে রাখা। #BangladeshCricket #RavichandranAshwin #TestCricket #somoytv

Russia's Druzhkivka offensive has begun, and we are entering a new phase of the battle for Donbas. Like how the Kostyantynivka offensive began before Russia fully capturing Chasiv Yar, the Druzhkivka offensive has begun before Russia fully capturing Kostyantynivka. At the same time, Ukraine has found itself in a dangerous situation in Dobropillya, as Russia makes a series of tactical breakthroughs. An advance up both banks of the Kazenyi Torets River (towards Druzhkivka on one side and Bilozerke on the other) appears to be the plan for now. Ukraine probably could have reduced Russia's advances by a lot in these areas if they weren't so focused on advancing in the south. Today, we celebrate the birthday of Arthur Jeffrey Dempster, who built the first modern mass spectrometer. A mass spectrometer is a machine that uses radiation to separate and measure charged particles in a material or sample. It is widely used in both industry and academia, as well as the work of the IAEA for research and development and for analysing and testing materials. As Dempster’s machine was 100 times more accurate than its predecessors, it meant he now had a tool sensitive enough to help him discover uranium-235. U-235 is a naturally-occurring chemical element and one of the most widely used materials for nuclear fission. Nuclear fission is what happens inside of a nuclear reactor, which then produces heat that is transformed into energy.

У 20-річному віці Сергій пішов на строкову службу, яку проходив у Дніпропетровській області. Працював певний період касиром у супермаркеті. Навесні 2023 року Сергій отримав повістку. Після ВЛК пройшов навчання та потрапив у 115 окрему бригаду Сил територіальної оборони. За словами матері, уночі 16 грудня 2023 року Сергій та ще семеро бійців вирушили на завдання, з якого повернулися лише троє військовослужбовців. Сергій Попович два з половиною роки вважався зниклим безвісти. У липні 2026 року ДНК-експертиза підтвердила його загибель. عظیم قربانیاں، تحریک آزادی کے رہنماوں کا غیرمتزلزل عزم اور اللہ تعالیٰ کی بے پایہ فضل و کرم کی بدولت آزاد مملکت کا خواب شرمندہِ تعبیر ہوا۔ تحریک آزادی کےتمام رہنماؤں کی ولولہ انگیز سیاسی جدوجہد و نسل مکمل آزادی کی ضمانت ہے۔ آئین و قوانینِ پاکستان تمام شہریوں کے حقوق کے ضامن ہیں۔ پاکستان کی ترقی و خوشحالی کا یہ سفر تابناک مستقبل کی جانب گامزن ہے۔ دفاع وطن، معیشت، صنعت و حرفت، عدلیہ، میڈیا، کھیل، تعلیم و ہنر، علماء، دانشور، اساتذہ، سائنسدان، زراعت و کاشتکاری اور بشمول عصر حاضر کے جدید شعبہ جات میں پاکستانی مرد و خواتین نے اپنی کاوشوں سے عزم وہمت کے باب رقم کئے۔ ہمارے باصلاحیت نوجوان، ہنر ہے۔ آج یوم آزادی پر پوری قوم بہادر افواج، قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں کے دلیر جوانوں, غازیوں اور تمام شہداء کی مقروض ہے جنہوں نے قوم کے مستقبل کی خاطر اپنی جانیں قربان کیں۔ آئیے، آج اپنے قومی عزم کی 3/3 🇮🇳 INDIA’S REAL CONTAINER OPPORTUNITY Build the container in India. Own the fleet from India. Finance it through GIFT City. Track it with Indian technology. Repair it near Indian ports. Lease it globally. Resell it at end-of-life. That creates an entire logistics-finance ecosystem around one steel box. Boxes are the entry point. Fleet control is the real game. 🇮🇳

2/3 📦 THE BOX ISN’T WHERE THE REAL MONEY IS A shipping container can live 10–15 years. During that life, it is leased, tracked, repositioned, repaired, insured and eventually resold. More than half of global containers are owned by leasing companies rather than shipping lines. That means the bigger prize isn’t simply MAKE IN INDIA. It is OWN + LEASE + MANAGE FROM INDIA.

U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) has issued a 'fact check' to correct what it describes as a series of false reports about conditions aboard the Nimitz class aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln (CVN-72), including claims that seven sailors died in a fight aboard the ship and reports of increased suicidal ideations among the crew. According to the Navy, no service members aboard Abraham Lincoln have died during its current deployment, and the sailor who went overboard on August 3 was quickly and safely recovered. The carrier strike group has now spent more than 260 days at sea, conducting more than 10,000 aircraft flights and expending approximately 1.5 million pounds of ordnance. The Navy also says Abraham Lincoln has maintained an 84.4% crew reenlistment rate, among the highest of any U.S. aircraft carrier. The statement comes as the Abraham Lincoln Carrier Strike Group continues operations in the Middle East following an exceptionally long deployment, with the Navy pushing back against what it says is inaccurate reporting about the condition and morale of its crew.

President Donald J. Trump has issued a memorandum directing a major overhaul of U.S. Navy shipbuilding, citing cost growth, delays, design complexity and insufficient industrial capacity. Among the key directives: • CVN-81: Within 60 days, the administration will develop a plan to replace the EMALS electromagnetic catapult system and Advanced Weapons Elevators with traditional steam and hydraulic systems. • Foreign shipbuilding: The administration will pursue a "Finland Model" allowing foreign shipbuilders to participate in up to three ship classes, provided they build or acquire a U.S. shipyard, train an American workforce, transfer relevant technology and establish a U.S. supply chain. The first two ships could be built overseas, with subsequent ships built in the United States. • New surface combatants: The Navy will develop a new competitive acquisition approach for affordable, mature-design surface combatants capable of anti-submarine warfare, surface warfare and convoy escort. • Fifth Navy shipyard: A plan will be developed for a fifth public Navy yard, including additional drydock capacity for nuclear-powered submarines and aircraft carriers. • Submarine repair: The administration will establish a Component Repair Center intended to maintain at least one complete set of spare equipment for the Los Angeles, Virginia, Seawolf, Ohio and Columbia classes. • NAVSEA reform: The Naval Sea Systems Command will undergo a review aimed at reducing bureaucracy, increasing accountability and preventing repeated redesigns of mature ship designs. The memorandum's overarching objective is to increase U.S. shipbuilding capacity and competition while reducing the cost and time required to build and maintain Navy vessels. Importantly, most of these provisions direct the Department of War and Navy to develop plans within specified timelines; they do not themselves immediately authorize or fund construction of the projects described.

За останні 3 роки та 8 місяців (44 місяці або 1350 днів) ворог захопив 23% Донецької області, а під контролем Сил Оборони України залишається 22.6% Хоч динаміка окупації Донеччини залишається у розрізі щоденних оновлень доволі жвавою, але в контексті контролю над усієї областю — дуже повільною. До повномасштабного вторгнення бойовики терористичних проросійських угруповань контролювали приблизно 32% області. За перші 40 днів вторгнення через провал оборони на півдні України та оточення Маріуполя, кацап зумів захопити ще 22.4% Донеччини. Після цього темпи просування спали, адже Сили Оборони стали від Великої Новосілки до Вугледару, а кацап стирався у штурмах ДонУРу (Донецького укріпленого району). Історичний факт, що німецький Вермахт за неповні 47 місяців умудрився від Західного Бугу дійти до Москви та Сталінграду, а також повернутися в Берлін. Натомість "друга армія світу" за майже аналогічний період дійшла від Донецька до Покровська. Яким чином американські партнери вважають такий "черепаховий наступ" козирем — зрозуміти складно. Хоча, звісно, і ми не в змозі за нинішньої конфігурації сил звільнити всі міжнародно визнані території. В цілому, якщо великих змін не буде, то для окупації всієї Донеччини кацапам треба буде не менше 3 років. І в чому тут козир — пишіть у коментарях до публікації. Video

Binaries are not human readable. They are equally inscrutable to software engineers and non-technical people. Since there is no source code, having a software engineer involved in the process adds nothing (except cost). Even to the extent that AI-generated software creates new demand for labor because of its limitations, it doesn't require highly paid software engineers and can instead be handled by lower-skill workers (perhaps just repeatedly yelling at the LLM to make no mistakes). what a terrible world compared to ours. yet this is exactly the situation for current image- and video-generator models! why is that? source code availability made it easier to build agentic pair-coder models for software... but it was still a ton of work to build out the interactive coding harnesses we have today, the models are expensively RL'd to be good at these harnesses, and in service of providing the software engineer lots of points to edit and steer and inspect the model's thinking process, they also leak lots of valuable information for distillation. it wasn't some inevitable law of the universe that we'd get agentic coders instead of something closer to "prompt to program" - markets are inefficient all the time - or that image and video models /had/ to converge on the text-to-artifact path optimized for generic, low-expertise edits like "move that over to the right." rather, i think it's better to look at who works at the labs. the labs are filled with software engineers, and they steered the development of models towards shapes that are useful as /collaborators/ instead of replacers. claude code was literally whipped up as an engineer's side project to help him work faster, before being promoted to an official project. meanwhile, to take a random image model company - Black Forest Labs says they are a "small team of 70" who are: > scientists, engineers and builders - battle-tested at the world's leading companies and research labs forgive me for noticing, but a certain type of person, and a certain type of experience, is strangely missing here... how many people at BFL do you think know e.g. what a photoshop layer blend mode is, much less has trained a model to help generate images for different ones? --- we could have had a world where image and video generators produce references, files with layers, take lists of shot directions, etc. - a world where diffusion models could act as real collaborators to experienced artists. in this world there still probably would've been artist backlash - artists are just a conservative bunch, see the reaction to digital art - but enough open-minded artists might've started working with the models that a virtuous cycle of increasingly better generative artist tools could've ignited. instead, there was a massive early backlash because of deliberately antagonistic comms, the models have stagnated in that early t2i UX with little improvement (image edits are just t+i2i, videos are still largely keyframed, node editors never reached much adoption, etc) despite huge jumps in raw capability. we have models that can produce whole worlds with a primary consumer base of... short form video attention farming slop? sora 2 even had the idea to do something different, yet "cameo yourself and your friends in a video" was the best they could think of. an embarrassing waste of talent. meanwhile as someone who draws, i still find it almost impossible to turn the image i see in my head into something on the screen using a model. there are a few brave artistic souls like gossip goblin building skill, swimming upstream against the model shape current, but for the most part years later these models are still languishing at a tiny fraction of their potential. i wish i could browse the top tweets about video generators and see beautiful thing after beautiful thing, real collaborations between humans and latent space. i think we will see that. but for now, it's dominated by grifters selling prompt packs they steal from each other and bluecheck monetizers recreating tacky versions of movie scenes to ragebait. --- why does this matter? because we're now at a similar point with math. despite the hype, models are not yet replacing human mathematicians - they've just reached the point predicted a couple years ago when people asked "why can't something that's read every publication ever make progress just by connecting ideas from disparate fields or noticing holes in the literature humans overlooked?" turns out that took a bit more capability than we thought in 2023, but we're there now. the models can gap fill and connect ideas. that's already impressive, to be clear! unlike with art, production of model math is not going to stagnate - there's too much economic value riding on it. it seems likely enough that at some point, maybe soon, the models will be capable of doing truly new math by inventing new constructions. we have the power to choose the shape of that - whether it's something human mathematicians can collaborate with and work into the existing cathedral of human math knowledge, or whether it's megabytes of self-contained 'verified' leanslop dumps that no human can interpret and "proof pdfs" in inscrutable model speclish produced by someone pulling the token lever without any need of understanding. in 2023, the labs went two ways. software engineers were worried about being replaced - and the labs instead built collaborators that made them, at least for now, 10x more effective. artists were also worried about being replaced - and the labs did their best to make it happen. the same thing is happening with math now. we don't have to end up in the world of "catching crumbs from the table," at least not yet. if we include experts in model development instead of laughing them off, we can Build the Math Harness properly. (most mathematicians can't code, let alone formalize things in Lean! models have the chance to be hugely helpful to the wider math community, not just a small contingent in the labs!) we can develop systems that at least have /some/ chance of empowering humans instead of slowly (and then all at once) disempowering us out of the knowledge production process. we have advantages this time. the labs employ mathematicians, and even the non-mathematicians at the labs have more respect for math than they do for art. but still, let's avoid poisoning the discourse. let's not force ourselves into the stupidest of all possible timelines a second time. be nice to the mathematicians.

China's population is shrinking. Its property sector has collapsed, and taken local government finances down with it. Prices at the factory gate have been falling for years. By most conventional measures, the Chinese economy is in real trouble. And yet, last October, China made a change to its rare-earth export licensing, which sent countries scampering to think about economic statecraft. How does a weakening economy end up with more leverage than ever? In this episode of Turbulence, Anupam Manur (@anupammanur) is joined by Manoj Kewalramani (@theChinaDude), who chairs the Indo-Pacific Studies Programme at the Takshashila Institution, writes a daily newsletter tracking the Communist Party's own People's Daily, and is the editor of Taming the Dragon: A Manifesto for a New Modus Vivendi with China. The conversation traces China's domestic slowdown, how Beijing exports its overcapacity through outward investment and green tech, what its rare-earth and critical-mineral controls are actually built to do, and how China has quietly de-risked its own economy from the US since 2018. امیرخان متقی، وزیر خارجه‌ب امارت اسلامی، در تازه‌ترین گفت‌وگوی خود با بی‌بی‌سی درباره‌ی وضعیت داخلی افغانستان، روابط با جامعه‌ی جهانی، به‌رسمیت‌شناسی، همه‌شمول بودن حکومت و آموزش دختران صحبت کرده‌است. متقی در این مصاحبه گفته‌است که مردم افغانستان از امارت اسلامی رضایت دارند و حکومت کنونی از حمایت سراسری در کشور برخوردار است. وی درباره‌ی روابط بین‌المللی امارت اسلامی می‌گوید که با بسیاری از کشورها روابط خوبی دارد و در حال حاضر بیش از ۴۰ سفارت و قنسولگری فعال در خارج از کشور دارد. وزیر خارجه هم‌چنین گفته‌است که به‌رسمیت نشناختن امارت اسلامی از سوی برخی کشورها، تصمیم خود آن‌هاست. متقی می‌گوید افغانستان می‌تواند با هر کشوری روابط تجارتی و دادوستد داشته باشد و روابط امارت اسلامی با شمار زیادی از کشورها به‌بود یافته‌است. او در مورد دعوت از شماری از مخالفان امارت اسلامی به مراسم تشییع جنازه‌ی علی خامنه‌ای رهبر پیشین جمهوری اسلامی در ایران نیز واکنش نشان داده و گفته‌است که امارت اسلامی در این زمینه شکایت خود را با مقام‌های ایرانی در میان گذاشته‌است. متقی درباره‌ی ساختار حکومت گفته که حکومت امارت اسلامی همه‌شمول است و زنان هم‌چنان در بخش‌های گوناگون شماری از اداره‌ها مصروف کار هستند. وزیر خارجه‌ی امارت اسلامی در مورد آموزش دختران گفته‌است که دختران در مدرسه‌های دینی درس می‌خوانند و آموزش آنان تا صنف ششم ادامه دارد؛ اما آموزش بالاتر از صنف ششم «تا امر ثانی» به تعویق افتاده‌است. #خبریک

Today we mark #PartitionHorrorsRemembranceDay. We recall the courage of all those who were impacted by Partition. It was a moment in history that tore apart several lives…families were uprooted, loved ones were lost and immense suffering was endured. At the same time, overcoming this, people rebuilt their lives from nothing, turned adversity into achievement and contributed immensely to our nation’s progress. Their life journeys remind us of the strength of the human spirit. May this day deepen our resolve to preserve harmony and brotherhood in our nation and collectively work towards building a Viksit Bharat.

On #PartitionHorrorsRemembranceDay, recognize the enormous human suffering and far-reaching geopolitical consequences of Partition. Salute the courage and resilience of those who rebuilt their lives. But we must also remember the painful lessons from this period of our history.

Conversei nesta quinta (13), por videoconferência, com a Presidenta do México, @Claudiashein, para tratar do relacionamento bilateral e trocar impressões sobre o contexto regional e internacional. Saudamos o bom andamento das tratativas entre a Petrobras e a PEMEX após memorando de entendimento assinado em junho e expressamos a expectativa de que projetos conjuntos entre as duas empresas se iniciem em breve. Reafirmei a importância estratégica de nossa parceria bilateral e reiterei nosso interesse de dar seguimento ao cronograma de negociações acordado durante a visita do Vice-Presidente Geraldo Alckmin ao México, no ano passado. Celebrei o restabelecimento das relações diplomáticas entre México e Peru, saudando a importância do diálogo entre países da América Latina. Lamentamos as catástrofes ocorridas na Venezuela e na Colômbia e a crise humanitária em Cuba. Transmiti à presidenta Sheinbaum proposta da Janja de lançar iniciativa internacional contra o feminicídio, que foi bem recebida pela presidenta. Reafirmamos a defesa do multilateralismo e nosso apoio à candidatura de Michelle Bachelet ao cargo de Secretária-Geral da ONU. Saudamos o bom momento vivido pelos dois países, que têm demonstrado resiliência frente aos desafios impostos pelo contexto internacional, e nos comprometemos a dar sequência aos contatos de alto nível para avançar em temas de interesse às nossas duas nações.

14 अगस्त 1947 का दिन इतिहास के उस क्रूरतम अध्याय का साक्षी है, जिसमें अमानवीय पीड़ा सहते हुए लाखों लोगों को अपना जीवन गंवाना पड़ा और करोड़ों लोगों को घर, संपत्ति व अपनों को छोड़कर विस्थापित होना पड़ा। देश के बँटवारे का यह दंश, जो कांग्रेस की देन है, उसे इतिहास कभी भूल नहीं पाएगा। इस विभीषिका में अपने प्राण गंवाने वाले और अत्याचारों के खिलाफ संघर्ष करने वाले सभी लोगों को श्रद्धापूर्वक नमन करता हूँ। मोदी सरकार #PartitionHorrorsRemembranceDay के माध्यम से इस त्रासदी की स्मृतियों को युवा पीढ़ी तक पहुँचा रही है, ताकि देश को फिर से तोड़ने वाली ताकतें कभी सफल न हो सकें और ‘एक भारत, श्रेष्ठ भारत’ ही हमारा सर्वोच्च ध्येय बने।

‘विभाजन विभीषिका स्मृति दिवस’ हमें भारत के विभाजन की त्रासदी का स्मरण कराता है, जिसने लाखों परिवारों के जीवन को गहरे दुःख, विस्थापन और अनिश्चितता से भर दिया। यह केवल इतिहास का एक पीड़ादायक अध्याय नहीं, बल्कि उन अनगिनत लोगों के संघर्ष, साहस, त्याग और धैर्य की स्मृति भी है, जिन्होंने अपना घर-परिवार, संपत्ति और स्वजनों को खोने के बावजूद, जीवन को पुनः संवारने का संकल्प दिखाया। यह दिवस हमें स्मरण कराता है कि इतिहास की पीड़ाओं को केवल स्मृति में संजोना पर्याप्त नहीं है; उनसे सीख लेकर ऐसा सशक्त, समरस और संवेदनशील भारत बनाना हमारा दायित्व है, जहाँ विभाजन का दंश कभी पुनः किसी समाज को न झेलना पड़े। देश के विभाजन की विभीषिका में अपने प्राणों की आहुति देने वाले सभी ज्ञात-अज्ञात लोगो तथा अपनी जन्मभूमि और जड़ों से विस्थापित होने वाले अनगिनत परिवारों के प्रति मेरी विनम्र श्रद्धांजलि।

This past week I’ve been asked several times by people of different ages “how do you research and publish so much?”. It’s awesome to be asked. I love sharing tips and I try to give my techniques for maintaining a research pipeline. But I also want to be honest about my reality. At times, it’s an unhealthy coping technique. I’m getting much better at it, but in the past I’ve not been so good. I’ve skirted psych wards on multiple occasions, been given a “multiple weeks off work with several therapy sessions” order, been on various psych meds, torpedoed family events and holidays etc... Social media highlights the wins, but I try and be honest about the lows too where I can. This industry is awesome, for many of us it gives us the chance to pursue our hobbies and passions. But it does encourage unhealthy routines. There is a reason that alcohol, drugs and mental health issues are embedded in infosec culture. And while sharing a new blog post or cool vuln can inspire people to want to be doing more, it shouldn’t come at the expense of a healthy mind. An old boss once said “we want you doing this for a long time, not doing a lot in a short time”.. I still think about this now. Stay healthy h4xx0rz! Adam Chester 🏴‍☠️ (@_xpn_) Whew, what a Christmas! Spent the end of 2023 and the beginning of 2024 in a total mess! I’ve tried to be open about my experiences with mental health, primarily OCD which has a nice way of spiking when I least expect/want it. But even with all the therapy, an amazingly supportive wife, and an awareness of my minds tricks, things have a horrible way of creeping in when you’re not aware! Then on top of that you add in the usual unforeseen life stresses, client deadlines, a report due yesterday, festive commitments, all while trying to put on a smile like everything is ok and hoping that you just make it through... and one way or another the downward spiral continues until you hit the bottom. Ignoring all the warning signs is easily done, even with years of experience.. But struggling to get out of bed, not being able to stomach food, and doubling your medication to just be able to function, all in the space of a few weeks… it just isn’t worth it. If this post rings true with anyone, therapy is a life saver! It’s one of the best investments I’ve made alongside a gym membership. I can’t imagine how I would cope without some of the techniques I’ve been given over the years.. you don’t want to find yourself in that “hopeless” position without a path to take to get back up again.. trust me 🙃 Unfortunately NHS waiting lists for seeing a therapist are 6+ months, but if you are lucky enough to afford private therapy… go for it, even if you think you don’t need it right now. I hope that someone out there who’s struggling or noticing the early signs of stress realises that these kinds of mental health issues are unfortunately common. Not many people talk about it in the open… but it happens to us all! Take care of yourselves h4xx0rz! — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/_xpn_/status/1745563669113487634#m

Grateful to the UN Special Rapporteur on the issue of the Independence of Judges and Lawyers for raising what BASL, the legal fraternity and this Opposition have said for weeks. We have to ask the simple question: why must this extension apply to the judges already sitting on the bench today? A government does not spend its political capital on a two-year adjustment unless it knows exactly whose two years it is buying. And everyone needs to understand what this means. If a government can decide how long a judge stays, that judge is no longer fully free to rule against the government. 1.1 million cases are pending. Not one is fixed by this amendment. If the Govt insists on the extension, they should have a Referendum, as the Supreme Court required in 2022. But first explain it to the people, in plain language, in Sinhala, Tamil and English what the implications are, before people can vote on the matter. OSINTdefender (@sentdefender) President Trump has directed the Navy to abandon the electromagnetic aircraft launch system (EMALS) being used on the Gerald R. Ford class carriers and return to traditional steam catapults, according to U.S. officials cited by the Wall Street Journal. Trump signed a national security memorandum directing the Navy to redesign the fourth Ford class carrier, Doris Miller, and subsequent ships around steam catapults. The first three carriers, Gerald R. Ford, John F. Kennedy and Enterprise, will retain EMALS. The decision reverses years of Navy and industry resistance to Trump's proposal, largely because replacing EMALS would require significant redesign and could cost billions of dollars. Trump has criticized EMALS for years, arguing that it is overly complex and less reliable than steam catapults. The move effectively locks in a major technological reversal for future U.S. aircraft carriers.
