Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey signed the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement on August 7. Reports indicate that the 3 countries have in essence agreed to a NATO Article 5-like clause—an attack on one signatory would be considered an attack on all of them. The agreement "reflects a change underway in the Middle East’s regional order—one that reduces the United States’ decades long leadership role," writes expert @stevenacook. The U.S.-aligned order could now become a Middle East with two blocs: the countries that remained committed to the Abraham Accords—the 2020 normalization agreements between Israel and Bahrain, Morocco, and the UAE—and its alternative, the Mecca Agreement, he argues. "Previously, regional rivalries and disputes were contained because leaders prioritized their relations with the United States, which was the tie that bound the regional order. Now, with the Pakistanis, Saudis, and Turks moving forward with a vision that competes directly with the Abraham Accords, that no longer seems to be the case," he writes. ہوں گے۔ وزیرِ اعظم نے سعودی عرب، قطر، کویت ، ترکیہ، آذربائیجان اور دیگر برادر اسلامی ممالک کے تعاون کا شکریہ ادا کیا اور کہا کہ ان سےہمارے تعلقات پھلتے پھولتے رہیں گے۔وزیراعظم نے زور دیا کہ جنگ کی طرح A new study shows Greenland's climate runs in bursts and reversals, not in a straight line of human-driven warming. Using over a century of Danish Meteorological Institute data, researchers found two short, powerful warming bursts: about 2.9C from 1922 to 1932, and 3.1C from 1993 to 2007, separated by a long cooling of roughly 3C between them. The result? No net warming in a century. The study links both warm phases to shifts in large-scale wind patterns, not CO2. Southerly winds brought warm air, while a return of northerly winds brought cold. Greenland's climate doesn't follow the smooth, man-made curve sold by models. It flickers with natural circulation changes. Today, Greenland is little changed from a century ago. Video

Thiruvananthapuram, Keralam: On the Lionel Messi Kerala visit row, State Minister & Youth Congress state President OJ Janeesh says, "The Sports Department’s report has been submitted to the Chief Minister, who has already made it clear that a decision will be taken after examining it. The issue is not simply whether the state government suffered a financial loss. The key question is whether the government followed the required due diligence. How was the private event management company selected? How did the government entrust the responsibility to them? Simply saying that there was an agreement is not enough. Several documents, including the agreement between the parties, are not available with the government. The government appears to have supported a private agreement without having complete clarity about it. Such matters require a detailed examination, and that is what is currently being done. There are established procedures that must be followed, and it appears that these procedures were not followed from the beginning. There is also a lack of clarity about how the government’s interests came to favour a private event management company. The files do not provide complete clarity, and the government has not seen the agreement between the parties. It is not enough for a minister alone to have seen it; the relevant documents must be available on the departmental file. There has been a lack of clarity from the very beginning. There was no reason for the government to act as an intermediary for a major commercial agreement involving a private company. The government will examine the matter and decide what kind of further investigation is required. There is no question of targeting or settling scores with anyone. The complaint was about the circumstances in which the government became involved in the proposal that Messi would come to Kerala. The inquiry is focused on the irregularities and lack of clarity that emerged during the examination. We are not acting against anyone out of personal or political vendetta, as some private channels may suggest. The examination is being conducted based on the complaints received." (13.08)

Thiruvananthapuram, Keralam: State Minister & Youth Congress state President OJ Janeesh says, "Keralam has decided to honour Malayali athletes who won medals at the Commonwealth Games. The Cabinet meeting held on Thursday decided to award Rs 20 lakh each to Sreesankar Murali, who won a silver medal in the long jump, and para-athlete Mohammed Basil, who won silver in the men’s 100 metres. A cash award of Rs 20 lakh each will also be given to Divi Bijesh, who won the Under-12 World Chess Championship, and Sandra Mol Sabu, a member of the Indian team that won gold in the mixed relay at the Under-23 Asian Games. Commonwealth Games swimming finalist Sajan Prakash and 4x400m mixed relay finalist Ansa Babu will receive Rs 5 lakh each. The coaches of Sreesankar Murali and Mohammed Basil will be awarded Rs 2 lakh each. Sreesankar had received Rs 10 lakh for his silver medal at the 2022 Commonwealth Games. Under the existing norms, athletes who reach the Commonwealth final are eligible for Rs 5 lakh, while medal winners receive Rs 5 lakh for gold, Rs 3 lakh for silver, and Rs 1 lakh for bronze. The government decided to increase the rewards after finding that the existing amounts were inadequate. The government’s declared policy is to make the sports sector more athlete-friendly and to avoid excessive politicisation of sports. Prize money for athletes who won medals at various national and international competitions has been pending since 2019. The government is making intensive efforts to clear the arrears inherited from the previous administration. As a first step, Rs 1.5 crore has already been sanctioned, and procedures are underway to release the remaining amount within the next few months.”

विकसित भारताच्या स्वप्नाला महाराष्ट्राची गती! मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस आणि अमृता फडणवीस यांनी आज मुंबई येथे भारताच्या स्वातंत्र्यदिनानिमित्त आयोजित स्वागत समारंभात प्रमुख उपस्थिती दर्शवली. भारत ही जगातील प्राचीन संस्कृतींपैकी एक असून विविधता, सर्वसमावेशकता आणि सहिष्णुता ही तिची प्रमुख वैशिष्ट्ये आहेत. पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांच्या नेतृत्वाखाली भारत अधिक सक्षम होत असून जागतिक स्तरावर महत्त्वाची भूमिका बजावत आहे. भारत आज जगातील चौथी मोठी अर्थव्यवस्था असून लवकरच $5 ट्रिलियनपेक्षा अधिक अर्थव्यवस्थेचे उद्दिष्ट गाठेल. गेल्या दशकात भारताने गरिबी निर्मूलन, पायाभूत सुविधांचा विकास, नवोन्मेष, उद्योग आणि कौशल्याधारित मनुष्यबळ निर्मितीमध्ये मोठी प्रगती केली आहे. भारतातील प्रतिभावान मनुष्यबळाने केवळ देशातील उद्योगांना नव्हे, तर जागतिक व्यवसायांनाही आकार देण्यास महत्त्वपूर्ण योगदान दिले आहे, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी केले. महाराष्ट्र हे भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्थेचे शक्तिकेंद्र असून देशाचे उत्पादन, तंत्रज्ञान, नवोन्मेष आणि स्टार्टअप क्षेत्रातील आघाडीचे राज्य आहे. मुंबई ही आर्थिक, व्यावसायिक आणि मनोरंजनाची राजधानी असण्यासोबतच जागतिक गुंतवणुकीचे प्रमुख केंद्र बनत आहे. मुंबई आणि पुणे या शहरांमध्ये ग्लोबल कॅपॅबिलिटी सेंटर्स (GCC) ची मजबूत परिसंस्थाही विकसित होत आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. मुंबई आणि नवी मुंबई परिसर डेटा सेंटर क्षेत्रातील प्रमुख केंद्र म्हणून विकसित होत असून वाढवण बंदरामुळे महाराष्ट्राची सागरी क्षमता आणखी मजबूत होणार आहे. नवी मुंबई विमानतळाच्या विकासासोबत 'तिसरी मुंबई' आकार घेत असून एज्युसिटी, मेडिसिटी, इनोव्हेशन सिटी, स्पोर्ट्स सिटी, जीसीसी सिटी आणि नवीन बिझनेस डिस्ट्रिक्ट्स यांच्या माध्यमातून एक शहरी इकोसिस्टम उभी राहत आहे. तसेच वाढवण बंदर ते विरार परिसरात 'चौथी मुंबई' विकसित करण्याची संकल्पना असून पालघर जिल्ह्यात विरारजवळ मुंबईच्या तिसऱ्या विमानतळाच्या विकासाचीही प्रक्रिया सुरू आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले. महाराष्ट्रात विविध क्षेत्रांसाठी औद्योगिक क्लस्टर्स विकसित करण्यात येत असून मुंबई, पुणे आणि मुंबई महानगर क्षेत्र ही पारंपरिक विकासाची केंद्रे अधिक मजबूत होत आहेत. त्यासोबत छत्रपती संभाजीनगर, नागपूर, गडचिरोली, नाशिक आणि अहिल्यानगर ही नवीन विकासकेंद्रे म्हणून पुढे येत आहेत. तंत्रज्ञान, संरक्षण, विमान वाहतूक, सीबीजी आणि स्वच्छ ऊर्जा यांसह विविध क्षेत्रांमध्ये मोठ्या प्रमाणावर गुंतवणूक होत आहे. या विकासप्रवासात विविध देशांचे राजनैतिक प्रतिनिधी आणि त्यांच्या अधिकाऱ्यांनी महत्त्वपूर्ण सहकार्य केले असून गुंतवणूकदारांना महाराष्ट्रात आणण्यासाठी त्यांनी दिलेले योगदान महत्त्वाचे आहे. या सहकार्यामुळे महाराष्ट्र आणि विविध देशांमध्ये नवीन भागीदारी निर्माण होत असून त्याचे रूपांतर आर्थिक प्रगतीत होत आहे, असे मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी केले. महाराष्ट्र $1 ट्रिलियनची अर्थव्यवस्था असलेले देशातील पहिले 'सब-नॅशनल एंटिटी' बनण्याच्या दिशेने वाटचाल करत असून 2029-30 पर्यंत हे उद्दिष्ट साध्य करण्याचा संकल्प आहे. येत्या 2 वर्षांमध्ये महाराष्ट्राची अर्थव्यवस्था सिंगापूर आणि युनायटेड अरब एमिरेट्सपेक्षा मोठी होईल. ही दोन्हीही राष्ट्रे महाराष्ट्राचे भागीदार असून त्यांच्याशी स्पर्धेपेक्षा परस्पर सहकार्याने विकास साधण्याचा महाराष्ट्राचा प्रयत्न आहे. पंतप्रधान नरेंद्र मोदी यांच्या नेतृत्वाखाली भारत न्याय्य, सर्वसमावेशक आणि समन्वयपूर्ण जागतिक व्यवस्थेच्या निर्मितीत अधिक महत्त्वाची भूमिका बजावेल. भारताची लोकशाही आणि तिरंगा ध्वज संपूर्ण जगाला प्रेरणा देत राहतील, असा विश्वास व्यक्त करत मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी भारताच्या 80व्या स्वातंत्र्य दिनाच्या औचित्याने आयोजित स्वागत कार्यक्रमानिमित्त सर्वांना शुभेच्छा दिल्या. यावेळी विधानसभा अध्यक्ष ॲड. राहुल नार्वेकर, विधानपरिषदेचे उपसभापती सचिन अहिर, A new study tested ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok and Claude with 100 politically charged questions — and found every major AI chatbot fell for falsehoods from both sides of the aisle while citing sources that literally don't exist. Of 419 sources the four chatbots provided, 104 webpages didn't exist, and 77 didn't actually answer the questions posed. Sources were valid less than half the time overall. The study, conducted by Just Facts, found ChatGPT and Gemini performed at a "C student" level, Claude at a "B student" level, and Grok scored better on left-leaning falsehoods but worse on the right — the reverse pattern of the other three. The researcher behind it says the takeaway isn't to abandon AI, but to never blindly trust it: "Don't trust, verify."

⚓📰 #USNAVY UPDATE: MCPON Leads CNO-Mandated Enlisted Readiness Council Master Chief Petty Officer of the Navy (MCPON) John Perryman led the inaugural Enlisted Readiness Council (ERC) Aug. 10-12, bringing together 30 senior enlisted leaders to identify systemic barriers to readiness and develop actionable recommendations for Navy leadership. Established by Chief of Naval Operations (CNO) Adm. Daryl Caudle, the ERC creates a direct connection between senior enlisted leaders across the Fleet and the Navy’s highest levels of decision-making. "The CNO and I spend a lot of time traveling the Fleet, talking with Sailors and their families about the things that make it harder to do their jobs, take care of their families and stay focused on the mission,” said Perryman. “Part of our responsibility as senior enlisted leaders is taking what we’re hearing, figuring out where we can make a difference and getting those issues in front of the people who can help us solve them.”

This week, 30 senior enlisted leaders from across the Navy came together for the inaugural Enlisted Readiness Council to identify systemic barriers to readiness and develop actionable recommendations for Navy leadership. Established by Chief of Naval Operations Adm. Daryl Caudle, the ERC creates a direct connection between senior enlisted leaders across the Fleet and the Navy’s highest levels of decision-making. Throughout the three-day council, members received guidance from the CNO, briefs from Capt. Charles Harmon, Enlisted Plans and Policy branch head, and Vice Adm. Scott Gray, commander, Navy installations Command, and received a Command Senior Enlisted Leader (CSEL) program update. Harmon provided updates on enlisted personnel policies and initiatives, including Senior Enlisted Marketplace and Billet-Based Advancement, while Gray addressed shore readiness and installation programs and services that support Sailors, families and Fleet operations. The discussions gave council members an opportunity to examine Fleet-raised issues alongside the leaders responsible for many of the policies, programs and resources that shape a Sailor’s service. Members worked through issue papers submitted from across the Fleet, examined potential barriers to change and identified issues requiring continued action through the ERC. The council will meet regularly and provide readiness assessments, recommendations, and issue-focused analysis to CNO for consideration, while issues requiring additional work will continue through the appropriate committee and tracked to ensure issues raised from the Fleet remain visible as decisions are made and actions move forward.

निर्मिती, चाचणी, पेटंट तसेच अनुदानाबाबत असलेल्या तरतुदी एकत्रित करून ड्रोन उद्योगासाठी ‘पॉलिसी ऑफ पॉलिसीज’ तयार करण्याची आवश्यकता आहे. राज्याचे ड्रोन धोरण इतर राज्यांच्या तुलनेत सक्षम असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. ड्रोन क्षेत्रातील संशोधन व विकास आणि स्वदेशी घटक निर्मितीला विशेष प्रोत्साहन देण्यावर भर देताना, विविध धोरणांमधील संशोधनासाठीच्या आर्थिक तरतुदी एकत्रितपणे उपलब्ध करून देण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. उद्योजकांना संशोधन, विकास आणि चाचणीसाठी उपलब्ध असलेल्या विविध योजनांचा एकत्रित लाभ मिळणे आवश्यक आहे. राज्यात आधीपासून कार्यरत असलेल्या ड्रोन FIRST ON FOX: Vice President JD Vance is referring a bombshell HHS report to the Justice Department that alleges hospitals deliberately pushed gender-affirming procedures on minors to cash in on fraudulent insurance claims — and he's calling for criminal prosecution. The report, titled "Wolves in White Coats," reveals more than $50 million in insurance claims for puberty blockers billed for patients ages 13-17 from 2015 to 2025. HHS says providers intentionally pushed gender dysphoria diagnoses on children to make puberty blockers, hormones, and surgeries easier to bill — a pathway paved by Biden-era policies promoting transgender equality. The average healthcare cost for a minor is roughly $3,000. If a child transitions, that figure jumps to $75,000 without surgery — and nearly $170,000 with gender-altering procedures. Roughly 225 hospitals nationwide have established pediatric gender programs. Vance's letter to AG Todd Blanche is blunt: providers who intentionally miscoded treatment to defraud Medicaid or private insurers "should go to prison."

YSR Kadapa district is transforming school meal delivery through the SMART Kitchen Initiative, combining technology, modern infrastructure, efficient logistics, sustainability, and community participation under the Aspirational Districts and Aspirational Blocks Programmes. Across the district, 38 SMART Kitchens now serve nearly 1 lakh children every day through 105 optimised routes and 95 dedicated delivery vehicles, ensuring timely and reliable delivery of nutritious meals. The initiative integrates centralised mechanised cooking, standardised food-safety protocols, GPS-enabled transportation, real-time monitoring dashboards, and QR-based feedback systems, making the process more transparent, traceable, and accountable. Sustainability is embedded in the model through solar energy, electric mobility, energy-efficient systems, and bio-digester-based waste management, while women-led Self Help Groups continue to play a vital role in community participation and local ownership. The SMART Kitchen Initiative demonstrates how convergence, technology, and community engagement can transform an everyday public service into a more efficient, sustainable, and people-centric system—advancing better nutrition and brighter futures for children. #SMARTKitchens #SchoolNutrition @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

NITI Aayog organised a Stakeholder Consultation on “Transforming Vocational Education in India: Vocational Education in Schools”, chaired by Dr. Joram Aniya, Member, NITI Aayog. The consultation brought together representatives from the Department of School Education & Literacy (DoSE&L), NCVET, State education departments, schools, Sector Skill Councils, industry, UNICEF, research organisations, and civil society organisations to deliberate on strengthening vocational education in schools. The discussions focused on meaningful skill exposure from Grade 6 onwards, strengthening teacher and trainer capacity, building stronger State institutions, deepening industry and apprenticeship linkages, expanding career pathways, promoting inclusion, and improving learner and employment outcomes. The consultation also emphasised the need for structured learning experiences and clear pathways connecting school education with further education, vocational training, apprenticeships, employment, and entrepreneurship, while encouraging the sharing of good practices and scalable models from States, schools, and industry partnerships. #VocationalEducation #SkillDevelopment @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

Diesel and gasoil exports fell to just 80,000 barrels a day in the first seven days of August, less than a previous low in July, according to Vortexa Ltd. data compiled by Bloomberg. Shipments were above a million barrels a day at the end of last year. The Kremlin imposed a diesel export ban in early July and later extended it through Sept. 1, though it excludes shipments under intergovernmental agreements. लगातार मोबाइल देखने से हुई एक्ट्रेस की हालत खराब, फोन एडिक्शन ने पहुंचाया अस्पताल; अब लाखों देकर करवानी पड़ी सर्जरी आजकल मोबाइल फोन हमारी जिंदगी का ऐसा हिस्सा बन गया है, जिसके बिना दिन अधूरा-सा लगता है. सुबह उठते ही फोन देखना, खाना खाते समय रील्स स्क्रॉल करना और खाली समय में गेम खेलना अब आम बात हो गई है. लेकिन जरूरत से ज्यादा मोबाइल चलाना सेहत पर भारी पड़ सकता है. साउथ सिनेमा की जानी-मानी एक्ट्रेस शकीला के साथ भी कुछ ऐसा ही हुआ. फोन पर घंटों समय बिताने की आदत के चलते उन्हें स्वास्थ्य संबंधी परेशानी का सामना करना पड़ा और आखिरकार अस्पताल जाकर सर्जरी करवानी पड़ी. शकीला ने अपने यूट्यूब चैनल पर शेयर किए गए एक व्लॉग में अपनी परेशानी के बारे में खुलकर बात की. उन्होंने बताया कि उन्हें फोन पर गेम खेलने की ऐसी आदत हो गई थी कि वो बेड पर लेटकर लगातार चार-चार घंटे तक गेम खेलती रहती थीं. . . इस दौरान वो सिर्फ चाय या कॉफी पीने के लिए उठती थीं. चाय खत्म होते ही उनका ध्यान फिर मोबाइल और गेम की तरफ चला जाता था. धीरे-धीरे गेमिंग के साथ रील्स और सोशल मीडिया पर समय बिताने की आदत भी बढ़ती चली गई. Les pongo un caso hipotético: Supongamos que Petro fuese abogado de profesión y que, haciendo uso de sus facultades, hubiera defendido a un magistrado que pidió una coima de $500 millones para “torcer” un fallo y que, además, hubiera comprado tierras que habían sido despojadas por guerrilleros. Supongamos que ese cliente fue condenado por la coima y obligado a devolver esas tierras. Y supongamos que, años después, cuando Petro llegó a la Presidencia, le entregara la Secretaría General del Ministerio de Agricultura al hijo de ese condenado. Seguro esto sería noticia nacional. Semana sacaría una portada superamarillista, Caracol haría un especial de media hora, Briceño publicaría cinco hilos y pondrían rugidos de tigre por todos los parlantes. Bueno, les cuento que esto sí sucedió. Solo que no fue durante el gobierno de Petro, sino durante el de Abelardo de la Espriella. Abelardo fue abogado del magistrado Jorge Pretelt, quien fue condenado por el caso de las coimas y señalado por la adquisición de tierras despojadas por paramilitares. Y ahora, el abogado de Pretelt le entregó al hijo de este el segundo cargo más importante del Ministerio de Agricultura. ¿Y ante esto? Silencio. Porque parece que todo lo que haga Abelardo durante estos cuatro años será aplaudido por los mismos medios que se rasgarían las vestiduras si los protagonistas fueran otros. Esto es escandaloso, terrible, grosero y burdo. Abelardo está poniendo el Estado en manos de personas cuyos círculos cercanos han estado rodeados de cuestionamientos por violencia, corrupción y despojo. Y si esto hubiera ocurrido en otro gobierno, ya estaríamos viendo portadas, especiales, editoriales y rugidos de tigre.

The Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Norway, H.E. Mr. Espen Barth Eide calls on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif. Islamabad, 13 August, 2026.

Islamabad: 13 August, 2026. The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Norway, H.E. Mr. Espen Barth Eide, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif at the Prime Minister House, today. The Prime Minister welcomed the Norwegian Foreign Minister and expressed satisfaction at the warm and cordial ties between Pakistan and Norway. He noted with appreciation, Norway's bilateral cooperation with Pakistan, particularly in the areas of education, skilled labour, climate resilience, and technology. While expressing Pakistan's strong desire to enhance bilateral trade with Norway, the Prime Minister invited Norwegian companies to invest in oil & gas exploration in Pakistan. During discussions on the regional and global situation, the Prime Minister deeply appreciated Norway's strong and principled stand in support of Palestine. He also thanked Norway for its consistent support to Pakistan's regional peace efforts in the Gulf region. The Norwegian Foreign Minister thanked the Prime Minister for the warm reception accorded to him and conveyed the good wishes of Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Støre to the Prime Minister. He praised Pakistan for playing a significant role in the regional peace efforts and reaffirmed Norway's interest in further strengthening bilateral ties across diverse sectors. The Minister particularly appreciated the positive contribution of the Pakistani diaspora in Norway. The Prime Minister extended an invitation to the Norwegian Prime Minister to undertake an official visit to Pakistan. The senior Federal Ministers, including Deputy Prime Minister & Foreign Minister Sen. Mohammad Ishaq Dar, Minister for Commerce Jam Kamal Khan, Minister for Climate Change Dr. Musadik Malik, Minister for Overseas Pakistanis & Human Resource Development Chaudhry Salik Hussain, SAPM Tariq Fatemi and other officials were also present. Helen Fazey, UK Ambassador to ASEAN, underscoring the strategic importance of ASEAN and UK partnership in nurturing regional creative ecosystem. ইসলাম একটি পূর্ণাঙ্গ জীবনব্যবস্থা। এতে সব বিষয়ের সুষ্ঠু সমাধান রয়েছে। মানুষের আত্মিক ও শারীরিক সুস্থতার প্রতিও ইসলামে গুরুত্ব রয়েছে। নবীজি সল্লাল্লাহু আলাইহি ওয়াসাল্লামের জীবনাদর্শে আমরা এমন কিছু খেলাধুলা ও শারীরিক প্রশিক্ষণের দৃষ্টান্ত দেখতে পাই, যা আজও সবার জন্য অনুসরণীয়। ইসলাম ৬ খেলাধুলায় উৎসাহ দেয়-- তীরন্দাজি তীরন্দাজি ছিল ইসলামের শুরুর যুগে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ সামরিক প্রশিক্ষণ। রসুলুল্লাহ (সা.) তীর নিক্ষেপ শেখাকে উৎসাহ দিয়েছেন এবং এটিকে মর্যাদাপূর্ণ কাজ হিসেবে উল্লেখ করেছেন। হাদিসে এসেছে, ارْمُوا وَارْكَبُوا، وَأَنْ تَرْمُوا أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ تَرْكَبُوا অর্থ: তোমরা তীর নিক্ষেপ করো এবং অশ্বারোহণ করো; তবে তোমাদের তীর নিক্ষেপ করাই আমার কাছে বেশি প্রিয়। (মুসলিম ১৯১৮) ঘোড়দৌড় ঘোড়া ছিল সে যুগের প্রধান বাহন এবং যুদ্ধ প্রস্তুতির অন্যতম মাধ্যম। রসুলুল্লাহ (সা.) নিজে ঘোড়দৌড় প্রতিযোগিতার আয়োজন করেছেন। হাদিসে এসেছে, عَنْ ابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ سَابَقَ بَيْنَ الْخَيْلِ অর্থ: হজরত আবদুল্লাহ ইবন ওমর (রা.) বলেন, রসুলুল্লাহ (সা.) ঘোড়াগুলোর মধ্যে প্রতিযোগিতার আয়োজন করেছিলেন। (বুখারি ২৮৭০) সাঁতার শিক্ষা সাঁতার একটি জীবনরক্ষাকারী দক্ষতা। ইসলাম মানুষের উপকারী জ্ঞান ও প্রশিক্ষণ অর্জনে উৎসাহ দেয়। রসুলুল্লাহ (সা.) বলেছেন, كُلُّ شَيْءٍ لَيْسَ مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللَّهِ فَهُوَ لَهْوٌ أَوْ سَهْوٌ إِلَّا أَرْبَعَ خِصَالٍ... وَتَعَلُّمُ السِّبَاحَةِ অর্থ: আল্লাহর স্মরণবিহীন সব কিছুই অনর্থক, তবে চারটি বিষয় ব্যতীত... তার মধ্যে রয়েছে সাঁতার শিক্ষা। (নাসাঈ ৮৯৪০) দৌড় প্রতিযোগিতা রসুলুল্লাহ (সা.) পরিবারে আনন্দ ও সৌহার্দ্য সৃষ্টির জন্য বৈধ বিনোদনের দৃষ্টান্ত স্থাপন করেছেন। হাদিসে পাকে এসেছে, হজরত আয়েশা (রা.) বলেন, سَابَقَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَسَبَقْتُهُ অর্থ: রসুলুল্লাহ (সা.) আমার সঙ্গে দৌড় প্রতিযোগিতা করেছিলেন, তখন আমি তাঁকে হারিয়ে দিয়েছিলাম। (আবু দাউদ ২৫৭৮) মল্লযুদ্ধ কুস্তি শক্তি, সহনশীলতা ও আত্মরক্ষার গুরুত্বপূর্ণ মাধ্যম। সীরাতগ্রন্থে বর্ণিত আছে যে, নবীজি (সা.) মক্কার প্রসিদ্ধ মল্লযোদ্ধা রুকানাকে কুস্তিতে পরাজিত করেছিলেন। এ ঘটনা প্রমাণ করে যে, একজন মুমিনের শারীরিক শক্তিও গুরুত্বপূর্ণ সম্পদ। রসুলুল্লাহ (সা.) বলেছেন, الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ অর্থ: শক্তিশালী মুমিন দুর্বল মুমিনের চেয়ে উত্তম এবং আল্লাহর নিকট অধিক প্রিয়। (মুসলিম ২৬৬৪) লক্ষ্যভেদ যে সকল খেলাধুলা মানুষের দক্ষতা, মনোযোগ ও আত্মরক্ষার সক্ষমতা বৃদ্ধি করে, ইসলাম সেগুলোকে উৎসাহিত করেছে। ঘোড়া প্রশিক্ষণ, লক্ষ্যভেদ এবং যুদ্ধ প্রস্তুতির বিভিন্ন অনুশীলন এ শ্রেণির অন্তর্ভুক্ত। হাদিসে এসেছে, إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُدْخِلُ بِالسَّهْمِ الْوَاحِدِ ثَلَاثَةً الْجَنَّةَ অর্থ: নিশ্চয়ই আল্লাহ একটি তীরের মাধ্যমে তিন ব্যক্তিকে জান্নাতে প্রবেশ করাবেন-- তীর প্রস্তুতকারী, তীর নিক্ষেপকারী এবং যে তাকে সহযোগিতা করে। তিরমিজি ১৬৩৭) #Islam #ProphetMuhammad #Sports #somoytv

Mali Yahalomi, 50, and her daughter Liel, 23, have been missing in Vienna for nearly 1 week, prompting an investigation involving Austrian and Israeli authorities. The 2 Israeli women were last in contact with their family on Friday, August 7, shortly after arriving in Vienna by train from Prague. Their disappearance has since drawn in Austrian police, the Israeli Embassy and Israel’s Lahav 433 serious crimes unit. A court imposed a gag order on parts of the Israeli investigation on Thursday, August 13, limiting what can be publicly disclosed. Mali and Liel began their European trip in Prague on August 4. On August 7, they took a train to Vienna and checked into a rented apartment. At around 5:45 p.m., they sent relatives a video saying they had arrived safely. Their final message wished the family “Shabbat Shalom.” The women are observant Jews and do not normally use their phones during Shabbat, meaning relatives initially had little reason to be alarmed when communication stopped Friday evening. They had also reportedly arranged to collect a meal from Vienna’s Chabad community but never arrived. According to reports, footage showed Mali and Liel leaving their apartment on Saturday, August 8, apparently on their own. Phone location information reportedly placed their devices around Vienna’s central railway station and a nearby public area. What happened after that remains unclear. When no message came after Shabbat, relatives became concerned. After repeated attempts to contact them failed, the family reported them missing to Israeli police on Sunday, August 9. The women were scheduled to fly from Prague to Ben Gurion Airport on Tuesday night, August 11. They never boarded the flight. Reports said their Vienna apartment was subsequently found without their belongings inside. No subsequent confirmed sighting, credit card transaction or other public trace of the women has been reported. The Israeli investigation has since been transferred to Lahav 433. A senior Israeli police officer with Europol connections was dispatched to Vienna, while Austrian police, the Israeli Embassy and members of Vienna’s Jewish community are involved in the search. Family members have also traveled to Austria. The search is complicated by Europe’s Schengen Area, where travelers can cross many national borders without routine passport checks. If Mali and Liel left Austria by land, their movement may not have generated an immigration record. Austrian authorities have said there is currently no evidence pointing to a criminal event. Israeli investigators have also reportedly examined the possibility that the women left voluntarily, citing circumstances surrounding the apartment and phone location data. The family strongly disputes that possibility. Relatives say suddenly cutting off contact would be completely out of character and argue that investigators should not rule out a criminal, antisemitic or nationalist motive. Rumors linking Mali’s disappearance to her employment at Bank of Jerusalem were also examined. The bank rejected any connection between her work and the disappearance, while reports said allegations involving financial misconduct were ruled out. On August 13, the Rishon LeTsiyyon Magistrate’s Court approved a gag order requested by Lahav 433 covering details of the investigation until September 13. The trip was intended as a mother and daughter vacation surrounding Mali’s 50th birthday. As of August 13, neither woman has been located and authorities have announced no confirmed breakthrough in the search.

From nearly 4,883 applications, 140 young researchers, representing 62 universities from across all four provinces, AJK, Gilgit-Baltistan, and a few from abroad, selected through a competitive process spanning 14 interview panels. Over six weeks, these interns worked across 14 research centres, technical sections, and projects at PIDE – contributing to ongoing research, building skills, and getting a real taste of what it means to work in a policy and research environment. The programme was not just an internship. It was a blend of hands-on work and structured capacity building – covering research methodology, data analytics, AI tools, policy analysis, and professional development. The cohort’s achievements speak for themselves: 41 knowledge briefs, 17 policy briefs, 13 opinion articles, 03 research papers, 01 web portal and 151 centre-level presentations. BOCA JUNIORS RESTAURARÁ EL HISTÓRICO CUADRO PINTADO POR BENITO QUINQUELA MARTÍN EXHIBIDO EN EL HALL DE LA BOMBONERA: “PUEDE VALER MILLONES” Boca Juniors anunció que restaurará el histórico mural pintado por Benito Quinquela Martín, que se exhibe en el hall principal de la Bombonera. Esta obra, creada en 1941, representa el vínculo entre el club y el barrio de La Boca y no se restauraba desde 2002. El cuadro, de grandes dimensiones, será preservado por especialistas y contará con nueva iluminación para resaltar su valor patrimonial. La pintura, titulada “El origen de la bandera de Boca”, muestra un barco con bandera sueca, referencia al origen de los colores del club, y refleja la identidad de los trabajadores de la zona portuaria. Aunque su valor en el mercado del arte podría alcanzar cifras millonarias, la obra no está en venta y es considerada un emblema incalculable para la institución y la comunidad. La restauración forma parte de una renovación integral del hall, que incluirá la recuperación de mármoles originales y la reorganización de placas conmemorativas. El mural de Quinquela Martín, símbolo de la historia y la cultura de Boca Juniors, permanecerá en un lugar central del estadio, reforzando la identidad del club y de su barrio. 📲 Lea la nota completa 📎 infob.ae/462P2B6

SpaceX asked American regulators in January for permission to launch up to a million satellites - for AI compute in orbit, running on sunlight. Musk's reason has little to do with space. In orbit there is no power plants to build, no grid queue to join and no neighbours to object. That's his reasoning. Before going 500 km up, America might look at the 758,180 acres it already controls across 545 military sites abroad - Bavaria, Spain, Qatar, Japan. The bottleneck at home: -~$130 billion of projects blocked or delayed in Q1 2026 alone — about as much as all of 2025 -Opposition groups up from 396 to 833 in four months, across 49 states -Grid interconnection now takes 61 months, up from 36 -Gallup, March: 71% of Americans don't want one near them Why the bottom layer decides this race: -China added ~540 GW of generating capacity last year. America added ~53 -27 nuclear reactors under construction in China. None in America -DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi and GLM are cheap and good enough for most commercial work - as models commoditise, the money moves to whoever can put power behind them Inference could be 70% of AI compute by 2030, and it travels: -tens of milliseconds don't matter when the model takes seconds to answer -Time to try secured land inside an American perimeter, with ownership rules and export controls written into the lease Spain first. Mr. Espen Barth Eide @EspenBarthEide, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Norway, led delegation-level talks at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Both sides reviewed the whole gamut of bilateral cooperation in various fields, including trade, investment, climate change, maritime affairs and education. They recognized the important role of the Pakistani diaspora in Norway and agreed to strengthen people-to-people ties between the two countries. The two sides expressed satisfaction at the warm and cordial state of Pakistan-Norway relations and agreed to further deepen cooperation in areas of mutual interest. They also held in depth discussions on regional and international developments of mutual interest. The Norwegian Foreign Minister commended Pakistan’s important and constructive role during the recent Iran-US conflict, including the leadership and contributions of Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif, Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar and Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir.

More than a quarter of the world's countries now live under sanctions. They have become the West's instrument of choice—the thing governments reach for when war is unthinkable and doing nothing is unacceptable. Freeze the reserves, cut off the banks, choke the exports, and force a government to change course without firing a shot. The fashionable verdict, after Russia's economy failed to collapse, is that sanctions simply don't work. In this episode of Turbulence, Anupam Manur (@anupammanur) is joined by Mark Harrison, a Professor Emeritus at the University of Warwick, one of the world's foremost economic historians of war and coercion, and co-editor of Economic Warfare and Sanctions since 1688. Reading three centuries of evidence, Harrison finds an interesting pattern: economic pressure has worked only when backed by force or the credible threat of it, which is the one thing the modern sanctions regime was built to avoid. The conversation runs from Napoleon's blockades to the chip war, asks why targets adapt faster than senders expect, and turns on an uncomfortable question for a country like India, caught between the sanctioners and the sanctioned. بلور دوازده‌ساله است که پدرش او را به مردی به‌نام سلیم مرغی می‌فروشد. به مردی با سابقه‌ای در گروه‌های افراطی و شهرتی در کشتن آدم‌ها. پدر از این معامله پول می‌گیرد تا بتواند خودش با دختری کم‌سن‌وسال دیگر ازدواج کند. این معامله، نه یک اتفاق نادر در داستان، بلکه بازتاب واقعیتی است که در بخش‌هایی از افغانستان هنوز جریان دارد. در جغرافیایی که دختر به‌عنوان کالا، به‌عنوان وسیله‌ای برای حل مشکل مالی خانواده یا ابزاری برای تأمین خواسته‌های دیگران دیده می‌شود. بلور اما ساکت نمی‌ماند. وقتی سلیم مرغی در غیاب پدر به خانه می‌آید، بلور بیل را برمی‌دارد و بر سرش می‌کوبد. این ضربه فقط یک واکنش دفاعی نیست؛ اولین‌باری است که بلور خودش درباره‌ی سرنوشت خودش تصمیم می‌گیرد. با علم به این‌که ممکن است هزینه‌اش را بدهد. بعد از آن، برای فرار از خشم خانواده، خودش را در جعبه‌ای برای نگهداری نان خشک پنهان می‌کند. این یکی از تلخ‌ترین تصویرهای کتاب است. دختری که باید اندازه‌ی خودش را کوچک کند تا بتواند زنده بماند. از همین‌جا فرار آغاز می‌شود. مسیری از قندهار به کراچی، از کراچی به چابهار، و از آن‌جا به تهران. هیچ‌کدام از این مراحل سفر عادی یک مهاجر نیست. در هر ایستگاه، خطر تازه‌ای منتظر است. راه‌های قاچاق، وسیله‌های ناامن، آدم‌هایی که معلوم نیست پناه‌ اند یا تهدیدی تازه. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/258991

Today is the birthday of Wolfgang Paul! This physicist was most famous for developing an electromagnetic device known as the Paul trap. Born on this day in 1913, Paul created traps, which are also known as quadrupole ion traps and radiofrequency traps, that use electromagnetic fields to ‘catch’ charged particles so that they may be analysed. These traps, which earned Paul & his colleague Hans Georg Dehmelt the 1989 @NobelPrize in Physics, are an integral part of mass spectrometers, which are large machines used for analysing characteristics of certain atoms, particles and molecules, and chemical structures. These machines are used in our safeguards activities to analyze samples for chemical elements like uranium and plutonium.

President Xi Jinping has always attached great importance to ecological conservation. Following in his footsteps across China, let's explore his vision of harmony between humanity and nature. (8) On Aug 23, 2021, Xi visited the Saihanba Mechanized Forest Farm in #Hebei province, where what was once a barren wasteland has become one of the world's largest man-made forests through more than six decades of efforts — an achievement Xi hailed as a "miracle". Xi met a couple of forest rangers who had been stationed at a watchtower for over a decade, asking in detail about their daily work and living conditions. He praised their quiet dedication and selfless commitment to safeguarding Saihanba's forests. Walking into the forest, Xi said that it truly felt different there and that the air was fresh. Standing beside a larch tree, he ran his hands along the trunk and said, "It's growing very well, with a straight trunk." Talking with staff representatives of the farm, Xi said generations of workers there have forged through concrete actions the Saihanba Spirit, featuring staying true to the original aspiration, being hardworking and enterprising, and pursuing green development. Today, #Saihanba has a forest landscape of 1.15 million mu (about 76,700 hectares). Its afforestation community took home the UN Champions of the Earth award in 2017 for its outstanding contribution to the restoration of degraded landscape. Xi said that Saihanba had nurtured one million mu of man-made forest, setting an example in the global history of ecological progress. #XiJinping #XiEcoVision #EcologicalCivilization Video

Up to $100,000 for a sham marriage and a shot at a green card. The DOJ says 11 people have been charged in a massive, decade-long marriage fraud network that allegedly connected mostly Chinese nationals with U.S. citizens in more than 1,000 fake unions. Authorities say the operation went far beyond paperwork. Couples allegedly staged wedding photos, dressed for fake ceremonies and were coached ahead of immigration interviews to make the marriages look legitimate. U.S. citizens were paid as much as $30,000 to participate. Prosecutors say the network even recruited at least 14 active-duty U.S. Army soldiers stationed in Kentucky. Officials believe the scheme took in tens of millions of dollars, with U.S. Attorney Jamie McDonald calling it one of the largest marriage fraud schemes charged in U.S. history.

VIDEO | PTI Exclusive: Former India cricketer and Rajya Sabha MP Harbhajan Singh (@harbhajan_singh) says, "The 'doosra' was a ball I saw Saqlain Mushtaq bowling on television. My friend Arun Verma is a wicketkeeper from Himachal Pradesh, and we were together at an academy in Chandigarh. I asked him, 'How does this ball happen?' I told him we had to try and figure it out. When you grip the ball for off-spin, it generally moves in a certain way. I started thinking about how I could alter the grip slightly by bringing my fingers together. I realised that if I did not impart the usual spin, the ball would come out straighter. I experimented with the grip and thought that instead of spinning the ball in the usual direction, I would try to roll my arm straight and keep the ball coming out straight. After practising for some time, I noticed that when I tried to spin the ball, it spun normally, but when I released it differently, it travelled straight. That is how I learned it - simply by bowling it again and again. I am glad Arun was there with me. He kept catching the ball while I kept bowling it, and through that repetition, I gradually learned the delivery." He added, "I also had a coach, Devinder Arora, from whom I learned many things. My career started when I began playing cricket under him, and he has remained my coach to this day. When I returned from London, I discussed the 'doosra' with him, and he told me to add more variations to it. He explained that if I rolled my thumb more, the ball would come out differently. It was these small technical adjustments and pieces of information that helped me keep correcting and improving the delivery. Gradually, the 'doosra' became hugely beneficial for me. It helped me get an opportunity to play for Team India. If I had not learned it or did not have that delivery, I would have simply been another off-spinner. I was asked what I could do differently, and I had something different to offer. That is how I got my chance to play for Team India." 🚨🇦🇺 Two of Australia's subsea internet cables, Indigo West and Indigo Central, were damaged last weekend inside the Submarine Cable Protection Zone off Perth. Authorities cited "very suspicious activity from a vessel near the location." Windward's multi-sensor analysis surfaced one vessel whose movements align with the location and timing of the damage. Here is what each sensor saw: AIS behavior first: The vessel entered Australia's EEZ on July 28, anchored off Perth, and loitered for nearly two weeks. On July 31 her reported ETA changed to January 1, 2027, a placeholder value typical of vessels with no genuine port call intent. Through August 8–9, the window in which the cables were damaged, her track shows repeated erratic crossings over the cable corridor. Then the satellites: Windward EO satellite imagery captured her on August 3 at 02:12 UTC, roughly 11 km west of Perth, off Marmion Marine Park. On August 8 at 21:42 UTC, SAR imagery placed her directly on the cable route. Any one of these signals can be argued with. An AIS track can be dismissed as noise. An EO frame proves presence, not behavior. A SAR return is a bright smudge on a purple field. Stack them and the ambiguity collapses: three independent sensors, one vessel, on the cables, at the time of the cuts. Fewer than 20 cables carry roughly 99% of Australia's internet traffic. Protecting them starts with knowing which vessel was there, and being able to prove it three different ways.

TimOnPoint (@TimOnPoint) The Precision Arsenal Trap The United States' precision-strike model is not failing because precision weapons are ineffective; it is failing because American military strategy, defense industry, and political incentives have become organized around weapons that cannot be produced at wartime scale. Over the past three decades, the United States has built a military that excels at delivering precise, low-risk, stand-off effects. Cruise missiles, stealth aircraft, precision-guided bombs, and sophisticated targeting networks can rapidly dismantle an opponent's command structure, air defenses, logistics nodes, and other high-value targets. These capabilities remain among the most formidable military advantages ever developed. Their weakness is not effectiveness. It is scale. Modern precision weapons are expensive, technologically complex, and produced at comparatively low rates. Against a capable adversary possessing large inventories, dispersed infrastructure, and an enduring industrial base, the United States can expend years of production in weeks of combat. The opening campaign may achieve remarkable tactical success, yet every launch steadily reduces a finite magazine that cannot be replenished at the rate it is consumed. This is not simply a munitions problem. It is a structural feature of the new American way of war. The United States has optimized for the first 30 days of a major war more successfully than it has optimized for day 300. Following the Cold War, precision strike became increasingly attractive because it minimized collateral damage, reduced risk to American personnel, satisfied increasingly restrictive legal and political expectations, and enabled limited military interventions without large-scale ground commitments. Operational success reinforced this model. Investment flowed toward increasingly sophisticated precision systems while comparatively little attention was paid to sustaining the industrial capacity necessary for prolonged, high-intensity conflict. At the same time, the defense industrial base underwent profound consolidation. The post-Cold War "Last Supper" reduced dozens of major defense firms to a small number of dominant prime contractors. Munitions production consolidated even further. As competition declined, these firms acquired substantial influence not only over production but over the definition of military requirements themselves. Requirements increasingly favored technologically exquisite, highly integrated systems that only a handful of incumbent contractors could realistically deliver. This influence extended beyond engineering. Long-established (sometimes questionable) relationships among Congress, the Department of War, prime contractors, defense consultancies, and the revolving door connecting senior military leaders, acquisition officials, industry executives, and lobbyists created a powerful institutional preference for continuity. Individual participants may (or may not) have acted in good faith, yet the system consistently rewarded familiar suppliers, established acquisition pathways, and incremental modernization over disruptive changes in production, procurement, or force design. The result was a self-reinforcing cycle. The acquisition system generated requirements for increasingly sophisticated weapons. Those requirements favored incumbent firms possessing the necessary intellectual property, manufacturing expertise, and political relationships. The resulting systems were exceptionally capable but expensive and produced in relatively small numbers. Military doctrine then evolved around the assumption that these weapons would remain available, reinforcing demand for the next generation of similarly exquisite systems. The consequence is visible whenever the United States confronts a marginally capable industrial opponent. Precision strike delivers devastating effects during the opening phase of a campaign, but its effectiveness declines as inventories shrink faster than production can replace them. The constraint is no longer tactical performance; it is industrial throughput. The consequence is not merely a shortage of missiles. It is a force structure increasingly dependent on single points of industrial failure. Every exclusive production line, proprietary interface, or single-source spare part becomes a potential strategic bottleneck during a prolonged war. This limitation becomes especially apparent when military objectives require persistent physical control rather than destruction alone. Precision weapons destroy targets. They rarely occupy terrain, deny access indefinitely, inspect facilities, or prevent an adversary from regenerating combat power. States possessing dispersed missile forces, hardened infrastructure, underground production, or resilient industrial networks can recover from repeated strikes so long as they retain physical control of their territory. Precision can suppress regeneration; it cannot permanently replace ground control. Political realities deepen this dilemma. Large-scale ground operations carry significant domestic political costs measured in casualties, duration, financial expense, and escalation risk. Yet ground forces exist precisely to perform the missions that stand-off precision cannot complete: seizing terrain, denying access, enforcing control, and preventing regeneration. The United States therefore finds itself caught between two politically preferred but strategically incomplete options: finite precision campaigns and the avoidance of large ground commitments. 1/2 — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/TimOnPoint/status/2085036585817362470#m

I expressed my gratitude for Japan’s unwavering support for Ukraine’s sovereignty and territorial integrity, as well as for the substantial practical assistance provided, in particular, to Ukraine’s energy sector. Through the Ministry of Energy’s hubs alone, Ukraine has received more than 113 tonnes of humanitarian aid, including 259 backup power units. Our partners provided assistance under various support programmes, including two gas turbines and mobile substations, 181 generators, 118 transformers, 6,400 gabions, and other essential equipment. We look forward to continued cooperation as Ukraine prepares for the 2026/2027 heating season, as russia continues its targeted attacks on our energy and gas infrastructure. We discussed the need to accelerate the procurement, with JICA’s @JICA_direct_en support, of 62 power transformers for frontline regions. One such transformer has already been delivered to the Kherson region, with another 27 supplied to the Mykolaiv region. Together with our Japanese partners, we are also working on procuring specialised equipment for gas production. We are equally interested in exploring opportunities for cooperation on the restoration and modernisation of Ukraine’s thermal power plants (TPPs) and combined heat and power plants (CHPs) during 2027-2030. We deeply value Japan’s support and our partners’ readiness to continue our cooperation in strengthening Ukraine’s energy resilience. Russia's rate of advance towards Dobropillia and Druzhkivka has increased in recent weeks. Small Russian infiltration groups from the 177th Naval Infantry Regiment have reached the southeastern part of Dobropillia, and other groups have made it north and northeast of Hannivka on the T0514 road moving from Novyi Donbas. Russia's 9th Motorized Rifle Brigade and 61st Naval Infantry Brigade are attempting to encircle Dobropillia from from the east/northeast using the high ground (including a height south of Stepy), while the 177th is approaching Dobropillia from the east along the T0515 road. Russian forces have reached the mine east of Chernihivka, which will serve as a hub for UAV crews (terricons provide valuable high ground for antenna) and infiltration groups. Russian presence in Bilytske (from the 5th Motorized Rifle Brigade), Chernihivka, and Matyasheve is increasing. To the east, Russia has advanced in Kucheriv Yar and Torske, placing its forces less than 9km from Druzhkivka. This is in part due to the reinforcement of this direction with the 90th Tank Division's 228th and 239th regiments (they took part in the July 22nd mechanized assault), which indicates it is a priority. Further Russian advances in this direction will pose a greater threat to Druzhkiva from the south/southwest, and Dobropillia from the east/northeast. Taking more high ground will also enable Russia to threaten Ukrainian logistics in both directions. In particular, Russian forces could put the Oleksandrivka-Kramatorsk portion of the T0510 road under fire control, which would complicate Ukrainian logistics. Russian forces are employing 15 inch fiber optic cable FPVs in this direction with a range of 50km with strikes in Novodonetske. Although Ukraine's middle strike campaign has raised the costs for Russia and complicated their logistics, Russia still has rough parity in FPVs in this direction and continues to receive sufficient artillery ammunition (the greater problem is the diversity of ammunition sources). The situation east of Kramatorsk and Slovyansk is also becoming more difficult (Russia's Southern Group of Forces was responsible for approximately half of Russia's gains in July), which will force Ukraine into a difficult choice where to commit reinforcements. Serving as the White House Press Secretary over the past year and a half has been the honor and adventure of a lifetime. I am incredibly grateful to President Trump for granting me so many extraordinary opportunities, such as working in the West Wing and spending countless hours in the Oval Office, flying around the world and meeting foreign leaders, and traveling across our beautiful country and meeting Americans from all walks of life. Most of all, I am thankful to the President for entrusting me with the distinct privilege of speaking on his behalf at the White House podium. I have spoken with great pride about the many historic accomplishments of this Administration, and I have relished holding the liberal media accountable and ensuring the American people hear the truth about President Trump’s successes. Being a mother and welcoming a new baby while working in one of the most demanding jobs in the world has been the most rewarding yet challenging season of my life, to say the least. Kenya has made tremendous strides in many sectors under Vision 2030, launched in 2008 by President Mwai Kibaki. Across the country, we have witnessed the transformation of our infrastructure and the delivery of landmark projects, including the Lamu Port, the Isiolo-Moyale road, and the Nairobi Expressway, among others. These achievements have expanded opportunity, strengthened connectivity and laid a strong foundation for our nation’s future. As Vision 2030 approaches the end of its course, we gathered at Nairobi's Kenyatta International Convention Centre to begin an important national conversation: What comes next? This is not simply a question about another plan or another set of targets. It is an invitation to imagine, together, the Kenya we want to become not only in the next decade, but also deep into the future. Soykırımcı Netanyahu hükûmeti, tüm dünyanın gözü önünde Batı Şeria ve Kudüs’teki hukuk dışı tasarruflarını sürdürüyor. İşgal, zorla göç ettirme ve gasp politikası maalesef artarak devam ediyor. Birleşmiş Milletler verilerine göre sadece 2026 yılında yerleşimci terörü, yıkımlar ve tahliyeler nedeniyle yaklaşık 3.800 Filistinli yerinden edildi, 100’e yakın Filistinli kardeşimiz katledildi. Bu durum, sistematik bir işgalin ve Filistin yönetimini kendi topraklarında nefes alamaz hale getirmeye çalışan bir yıpratma stratejisinin ürünüdür. Ama tüm sindirme ve tehcir teşebbüslerine rağmen Filistin halkı dimdik ayaktadır. Bu tablo karşısında Sayın Abbas’la görüşmemizde yapılabilecekleri değerlendirdik. Gazze’de yeniden imar ve inşa sürecinin başlatılması ve güvenliğin temini için gerekli koşullar bir an önce sağlanmalıdır. Uzun bir süreden sonra Filistin’de gerçekleştirilmesi öngörülen yasama ve başkanlık seçimleri kararının hayırlara vesile olmasını diliyoruz. Some maps help you find your way. Others help you see the world differently. 🗺️🎨 Our 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) captures the shape of the land through high-resolution elevation data. Through our 3DEP as Art series, we transform these scientific datasets into visual representations of elevation, revealing the ridges, valleys, and slopes that shape the terrain. Created from bare-earth elevation data, these maps remove vegetation and structures to showcase the underlying terrain in a new way. This data supports a wide range of applications, including mapping, natural resource management, hazard assessment, scientific research, and informed decision-making. Google has quietly stopped searching by Exact Phrase when you use quotes. Now by default Google will return pages and pages of results you don't want. Google now thinks you use quotation marks for no reason even though quotes have specifically been the correct format for exact phrase searches on Google. Maddenly, even using the Advanced Search page and the "This exact word or phrase" text box no longer searches by exact phrase. I was trying to see if the air purifier company IQAir ever mentioned a key air filtration term on their website. So I typed in an exact phrase search for just the IQAir website: " "most penetrating particle size" site:iqair.com/ " What I got was 6 useless pages of links to pages that do not contain the exact phrase "most penetrating particle size," but instead contain some or all of the words. That's the result I should get when I don't use quotation marks. You can fix this behavior on a search results page by going to the "Tools" drop down menu and changing the "All results" setting to "Verbatim". There is no way to set Verbatim as the default for future searches AFAIK.

Le sorgenti dell'Apartheid🧵 Cisgiordania. Le sorgenti di Nabi Aner sono di proprietà privata di una famiglia palestinese, sono aperte a tutti, chiunque può sostare o fare un bagno, gli agricoltori utilizzano l'acqua per irrigare i campi. È stato sempre così, fino al 2014, quando un gruppo di coloni assalta e occupa le sorgenti, arrivano i militari che delimitano il sito e vietano l'accesso ai proprietari e agli agricoltori costretti ad abbandonare i terreni oramai inariditi. Il sito è diventato un parco per turisti israeliani. Secondo i dati ONU, negli ultimi 15 anni i coloni hanno occupato oltre 50 fonti d'acqua nella Cisgiordania centrale, tutte di proprietà palestinese, quasi tutte acquisite illegalmente dallo Stato occupante, rinominate e usate per scopi turistici ad uso esclusivo degli israeliani. L'apoteosi dell'illegalità. Nel 2019, il celebre giornalista israeliano Gideon Levy volle visitare alcuni siti occupati, nacque un reportage straordinario. Scrisse Gideon Levy "In queste sorgenti di Anar Springs, sorgenti di Apartheid, dalle finestre delle loro case, i proprietari palestinesi possono solo guardare con disperazione i loro antichi uliveti trascurati. Gli alberi sono uno spettacolo pietoso, sembrano chiedere aiuto" "Molte di queste sorgenti rubate sono deserte, i visitatori sono rari, i terreni intorno sono incolti e abbandonati, mucchi di immondizia si accumulano senza pietà" All'ingresso della sorgente di Anar Springs c'è un cartello che è la rappresentazione plastica di una società che non conosce il senso della vergogna "Cari escursionisti, benvenuti ad Anar Springs costruita grazie a un intenso lavoro dei giovani di Nira [*i giovani di Nira sono i coloni dell'avamposto illegale che hanno occupato il sito] Abbiamo costruito il sito per il tuo bene e per il bene del popolo di Israele. Il nostro obiettivo è che TUTTI possano fare escursioni e godere insieme delle sorgenti" Gideon Levy chiede a un militare di guardia al sito: "Possono entrare tutti? A qualcuno è vietato entrare qui?" "È vietato agli arabi" risponde il militare. Un altro soldato interviene per precisare: "Questo posto è riservato solo agli ebrei".

وزارت امور خارجه ایالات متحده اعلام کرده است که برای مقابله با روش‌های سازمان‌یافتۀ "گردشگری تولد" که از قوانین ویزۀ ایالات متحده سواستفاده می‌کنند، اقدامات جدی را آغاز کرده است. مارکو روبیو، وزیر خارجۀ ایالات متحده در پیامی در شبکۀ ایکس نگاشته است: "شهروندی امریکا برای فروش نیست." شهروندان کشورهای دیگر با استفاده از این روش برای به دنیا آوردن فرزند به امریکا می آیند، تا کودکان آنان بتوانند تابعیت امریکا را به دست آورند. گروه ویژۀ کاری پیشگیری از گردشگری تولد در وزارت امور خارجۀ امریکا، فعالیت‌های مربوط به ویزه را بررسی کرده، شبکه‌های غیرقانونی را هدف قرار داده و اتهامات مربوط به تقلب، از جمله جعل اسناد و ارایه درخواست‌های گمراه‌کننده برای ویزه را بررسی می‌کند. بر اساس اعلامیۀ وزارت امور خارجۀ امریکا، این گروه ویژه کاری در نخستین ماه فعالیت خود بیش از ۶۰۰ ویزه را لغو کرده است. مقام‌ها می‌گویند که این اقدامات به‌عنوان بخشی از تلاش گسترده‌تر برای متلاشی کردن شبکه‌های گردشگری تولد و حفاظت از یکپارچگی قوانین مهاجرت و تابعیت امریکا ادامه خواهد یافت. دونالد ترمپ، رییس‌جمهور ایالات، در ششم اگست دو فرمان اجرایی درباره تابعیت بر اساس تولد و جلوگیری از "گردشگری تولد" صادر کرد. هدف این فرمان‌ها محدود کردن تابعیت در برخی موارد و جلوگیری از سفر افرادی است که به‌منظور تولد فرزند و دریافت تابعیت امریکا برای نوزاد شان وارد این کشور می‌شوند. قصر سفید می‌گوید که این اقدامات بر قوانین مهاجرتی و صلاحیت‌های اجرایی موجود استوار است. با این حال، تلاش قبلی رییس جمهور ترمپ برای تغییر قانون تابعیت بر اساس تولد با مخالفت محکمه عالی امریکا روبه‌رو شده بود. wxyz.page/LK52k

At the Permanent Council session to commemorate the International Day of the World's Indigenous Peoples, within the framework of the Ninth Inter-American Week, I emphasized something fundamental: we must genuinely listen to Indigenous elders and peoples. Their knowledge and their ways of governing through consensus are not relics; they are urgent solutions. Yet, the @CIDH and the Inter-American Court @CorteIDH have documented with painful clarity the discrimination, exclusion, and violence they continue to face—a burden disproportionately borne by Indigenous women. The American Declaration is our hemisphere's most significant response, but good intentions without political will and resources are not enough. Indigenous rights must no longer be a matter for negotiation, but a living reality. Our obligation is to stand firmly beside them. #OASIndigenousWeek #WeAreIndigenous Video

A CUÁNTO LLEGARÁN EL DÓLAR Y LA INFLACIÓN A FINES DE 2027: LOS DOS ESCENARIOS QUE PROYECTÓ UNA CALIFICADORA DE RIESGO Las proyecciones para el futuro inmediato de la economía argentina surgen de un informe de FixScr, filial local de una de las agencias globales más relevantes. Incluyen estimaciones de dólar, inflación, actividad, saldo comercial y tasa de interés en base a un presupuesto optimista y otro pesimista. La evolución del dólar, la inflación y otras variables clave durante los próximos fue el foco de un reciente informe de FixScr, la filial en Argentina, Uruguay y Paraguay del gigante mundial de la calificación de riesgo, Fitch Ratings. El estudio anticipa dos trayectorias posibles para las principales variables macroeconómicas, diferenciando un escenario base, considerado de mayor probabilidad, de uno alternativo, de tono más pesimista y menor posibilidad de ocurrencia. En base al desempeño del programa de Javier Milei, el primer escenario contempla un dólar de $2.047 para fines de 2027 si todo sale bien. En caso de que la recuperación sea más dura, en cambio, esa variable terminaría 2027 a $2.246 por unidad. Infobae 📎 infob.ae/4x2Auh6

A delegation led by Minister of Energy of the Republic of Belarus H.E. Dzenis Maroz called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif in Islamabad on 12 August 2026.

ISLAMABAD: 12 August 2026. H.E. Mr. Dzenis Maroz, Minister for Energy of the Republic of Belarus, who is currently on an official visit to Pakistan, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif at the Prime Minister House, this afternoon. While welcoming the Belarusian Minister and his delegation, the Prime Minister conveyed his warm greetings and good wishes for President Alexander Lukashenko. He fondly recalled President Lukashenko’s visit to Islamabad in November 2024, as well as his own visit to Belarus in April 2025, that further strengthened bilateral ties across all spheres of shared interest. The Prime Minister expressed satisfaction over the productive deliberations held during the 9th Session of the Joint Ministerial Commission (JMC) held in Islamabad, wherein the two sides reviewed the entire spectrum of bilateral cooperation, including in trade, industry, agriculture, banking, labour, transport, and energy sectors. Both sides expressed confidence that the outcomes of the JMC would translate into tangible benefits for both countries and further consolidate the growing partnership between Pakistan and Belarus. The visiting Minister thanked the Prime Minister for the gracious welcome, and conveyed the warm regards of the Belarusian leadership. He briefed the Prime Minister on the substantive progress made during the JMC meeting. Both sides reaffirmed their commitment to further deepen bilateral coordination to materialize cooperation across all sectors agreed between the leadership of two countries. Video

The discussions highlighted the importance of sustained R&D, pilot projects and an enabling policy and regulatory framework to build confidence for large-scale deployment. Developing a credible pathway from estimated potential to proven storage capacity will be critical for unlocking the role of geological carbon storage in India’s energy transition. #CCUS #CarbonStorage

The roundtable focused on the potential of geological storage as a key component of India’s Carbon Capture, Utilisation and Storage (CCUS) strategy. India has significant geological potential for storing CO₂, including in deep saline aquifers and basalt formations. The key challenge is to translate this potential into safe, reliable and cost-effective storage solutions through a source-to-sink approach supported by field evidence and demonstration projects.

Young people are on average the healthiest part of society, but are at particular risk of health threats including mental health conditions, loneliness, violence and road traffic crashes. Addressing their health needs is essential to achieving health for all. Over the past nine years, WHO has made a concerted effort to include the voices and ideas of young people in our work, as part of the WHO Transformation. We recognize young people not just as beneficiaries of our work, but as critical partners in achieving global health goals. That’s why in 2023 we launched the @WHOYouthCouncil, a network to advise WHO and ensure that youth voices are not only heard but are instrumental in influencing policy and actions. Through the Youth Council, WHO aims to co-create solutions that are youth-led, youth-driven, and tailored to their specific health needs. "Earlier this week, the government of the United States announced a significant change in its policy for childhood vaccination. Every parent wants to keep their children safe, and vaccines are among the most powerful tools for doing that. WHO is concerned that the changes to immunization policy in the U.S. are not aligned with the best science. Decades of evidence have shown when children are most vulnerable to disease, when vaccines provide the strongest protection, how many doses are needed, and which vaccines can safely be given together. That evidence is reviewed continuously as new data emerge from across the globe. And the current evidence is unequivocal: vaccines – including the MMR vaccine – are safe and do not cause autism. Delaying vaccines or separating doses unnecessarily does not make vaccination safer, and can leave children unprotected. Vaccination policy should be guided by rigorous, independent and transparent review of the best available science, and not by political influence"-@DrTedros
